Swap Places.name: Swap Places
Swap Places.description: The character swaps places with someone else.
Swap Places.effect: The character swaps places with another person they can see within range. When the effect ends, the character and the other person swap places again. If the person being swapped with is unwilling, the character must make an Ego check against that person's Vigilance defense to succeed.
Swap Places.short_effect:
Teleport and swap places with a visible person within range
Unwilling target requires Ego vs. Vigilance check

Swap Powers.name: Swap Powers
Swap Powers.description: The character swaps their powers for a target's powers.
Swap Powers.effect: The character makes an Ego attack against a target they can see within range. The character must pay the highest cost of the target's powers, or a minimum of 10 Focus. On a success, they swap all of their non-Swap powers with the target's powers. Both characters can now use their new powers as if they had always had them. When either character uses a swapped power, they must pay any cost for it normally as well.
Swap Powers.short_effect:
Ego attack vs. visible target within range
• Success: Swap all non-Swap powers with target (both use new powers normally)
• Cost: Target's highest power cost or 10 Focus minimum

Swap Status.name: Swap Status
Swap Status.description: The character swaps status with someone else.
Swap Status.effect: The character swaps status with a target they can see within range. The character can swap their entire status with the target, or be selective. Statuses that can be swapped include: Lost Health, Lost Focus, Any condition, Occupation, Traits, Tags. When swapping lost Health or Focus, both take their maximum and subtract what the other person has lost at that moment. The same thing happens when the effect ends, which could potentially kill or shatter someone. When swapping occupations, the character gains the target's position, authority, and responsibilities. When the effect ends, any alterations that have happened to either character swap back to the other (e.g., if one character is killed while the other lives).
Swap Status.short_effect:
Swap entire or selected status (Lost Health/Focus, Conditions, Occupation, Traits, Tags) with a visible target within range
5 Focus cost
Reverts when effect ends, with extreme caution required

Understand Body Language.name: Understand Body Language
Understand Body Language.description: The character can read how a person holds themself.
Understand Body Language.effect: When the character encounters a culture for the first time, they can make a Logic vs. TN 13 action check to puzzle out its body language. If they already know any other version of the culture's language, they have an edge. On a success, they understand and can emulate the body language. On a Fantastic success, they permanently understand and can use it and never need to make a check for it again. This covers full-body language and body language that communicates more than a target's words (e.g., aggression, shyness).
Understand Body Language.short_effect:
Logic vs. TN 13 to understand new culture's body language (edge if know related language)
Fantastic: Permanent understanding

Understand Code.name: Understand Code
Understand Code.description: The character can figure out any kind of code.
Understand Code.effect: When the character encounters an unknown code for the first time, they can make a Logic vs. TN 13 action check to puzzle it out. If they already know any other version of the language the code is based on, they have an edge. On a success, they understand and can communicate in the code. On a Fantastic success, they permanently understand and can use it and never need to make a check for it again. Digital data communication is considered a form of code, and the character can use this power to understand such data too.
Understand Code.short_effect:
Logic vs. TN 13 to understand unknown code (edge if know related language)
Fantastic: Permanent understanding
Works on digital data too

Understand Sign Language.name: Understand Sign Language
Understand Sign Language.description: The character can get what someone is signing.
Understand Sign Language.effect: When the character encounters an unknown sign language for the first time, they can make a Logic vs. TN 13 action check to puzzle it out. If they already know any other version of the language, they have an edge. On a success, they understand and can sign in the language. On a Fantastic success, they permanently understand and can use it and never need to make a check for it again.
Understand Sign Language.short_effect:
Logic vs. TN 13 to understand new sign language (edge if know related language)
Fantastic: Permanent understanding

Understand Spoken Language.name: Understand Spoken Language
Understand Spoken Language.description: The character can get what someone is saying.
Understand Spoken Language.effect: When the character encounters an unknown spoken language for the first time, they can make a Logic vs. TN 13 action check to puzzle it out. If they already know any other version of the language, they have an edge. On a success, they understand and can speak the language. On a Fantastic success, they permanently understand and can speak it and never need to make a check for it again.
Understand Spoken Language.short_effect:
Logic vs. TN 13 to understand new spoken language (edge if know related language)
Fantastic: Permanent understanding

Understand Unusual Communication.name: Understand Unusual Communication
Understand Unusual Communication.description: The character can understand any other form of communication.
Understand Unusual Communication.effect: When the character encounters an unknown form of communication for the first time—one that doesn't depend on hearing, vision, or code—they can make a Logic vs. TN 13 action check to puzzle it out. If they already know any other version of the communication, they have an edge. On a success, they understand and can use that form of communication. On a Fantastic success, they permanently understand and can use it and never need to make a check for it again. This works with forms of communication that include other senses, like scent, touch, taste and so on.
Understand Unusual Communication.short_effect:
Logic vs. TN 13 to understand unusual communication (not hearing/vision/code)
Fantastic: Permanent understanding

Understand Written Language.name: Understand Written Language
Understand Written Language.description: The character can figure out what someone has written.
Understand Written Language.effect: When the character encounters an unknown written language for the first time, they can make a Logic vs. TN 13 action check to puzzle it out. If they already know any other version of the language, they have an edge. On a success, they can read and write the language. On a Fantastic success, they can permanently read and write it and never need to make a check for it again.
Understand Written Language.short_effect:
Logic vs. TN 13 to read/write new written language (edge if know related language)
Fantastic: Permanent understanding

Wish You Luck.name: Wish You Luck
Wish You Luck.description: The character can make a friend lucky, even from across the room.
Wish You Luck.effect: The character picks an ally in line of sight. That ally gains an edge on all action checks made while this power is in effect. There is no limit on the range between the character and the ally once the power is activated. The character must pay the Focus cost at the start of each of their subsequent turns of concentration to keep the power working.
Wish You Luck.short_effect:
Ally in line of sight gains edge on all checks
Pay Focus at start of each turn to maintain

Never Surrender.name: Never Surrender
Never Surrender.description: The character can help a friend rally.
Never Surrender.effect: The character can eliminate the effects of a target losing all of their Focus. Rather than becoming demoralized, the target can function normally without having trouble on all their actions due to their lack of Focus. They cannot spend more Focus, though, and they can still be shattered. Once the power takes effect, the target does not have to remain within the character's reach. When the effect ends, if the target has 0 Focus or less, they become demoralized. If the target's Focus rises above 0 at any point, this power automatically ends.
Never Surrender.short_effect:
Target within reach functions normally at 0 Focus (not demoralized, no trouble)
Cannot spend Focus; can still be shattered
Ends when Focus >0 or effect ends (then demoralized if still 0)

Postcognition 1.name: Postcognition 1
Postcognition 1.description: The character knows what just happened.
Postcognition 1.effect: The character can sense what happened to a particular person, place, or item within their reach—including themselves—in the past six hours. If analyzing a person, the character senses events from that person's point of view, using that person's senses. If the person is unconscious, dead, or otherwise senseless at any point, the character cannot sense anything at those points either. If analyzing a place, the character senses everything that happened in that place over that period of time, using their own senses. The character appears to be standing in their current location and position. If analyzing an item, the character senses how the item was affected or used over that period of time, no matter where it was located or how it moved. They can sense things as if the item had their senses. The character can fast-forward and rewind through the period of time and stop at interesting parts, allowing them to play out in real time.
Postcognition 1.short_effect:
Sense what happened to person/place/item within Reach in past 6 hours
If analyzing event ≥Rank spaces away: Logic check

Postcognition 2.name: Postcognition 2
Postcognition 2.description: The character knows what happened in the past day.
Postcognition 2.effect: The character can sense what happened to a particular person, place, or item within their reach—including themselves—in the past 24 hours. Otherwise, this power works the same as Postcognition 1.
Postcognition 2.short_effect: Sense what happened to person/place/item within Reach in past 24 hours

Postcognition 3.name: Postcognition 3
Postcognition 3.description: The character knows what happened in the past year.
Postcognition 3.effect: The character can sense what happened to a particular person, place, or item within their reach—including themselves—in any 24-hour period in the past year. Otherwise, this power works the same as Postcognition 1.
Postcognition 3.short_effect: Sense what happened to person/place/item within Reach in any 24h period in past week

Postcognition 4.name: Postcognition 4
Postcognition 4.description: The character knows what happened in the past century.
Postcognition 4.effect: The character can sense what happened to a particular person, place, or item within their reach—including themselves—in any week-long period in the past century. Otherwise, this power works the same as Postcognition 1.
Postcognition 4.short_effect: Sense what happened to person/place/item within Reach in any week in past month

Power Slider.name: Power Slider
Power Slider.description: The character's power waxes and wanes with what's vital to them.
Power Slider.effect:
The character has a single criterion (Confidence, Faith, or Media Popularity) that affects the strength of their powers on a spectrum, starting off normal, but becoming boosted or dampened. 

**Boosted (Going Well):** All other powers are boosted. Ranges, effective areas, or durations are doubled. Damage multipliers add 1 to the effects. Effects that normally happen on a Fantastic success automatically happen on any success. Anything that would dampen their powers only brings them back to normal. 

**Dampened (Going Poorly):** All other powers are dampened. Ranges, effective areas, or durations are halved. Damage multipliers subtract 1 from the effects. The power can no longer enjoy Fantastic successes. Anything that would boost their powers only brings them back to normal. 

These effects last for a single combat or, if outside of combat, a single day. 

**Criteria:** 
* **Confidence:** Fantastic success on an important action check boosts; failure on an important action check dampens. 
* **Faith:** Something the character believes as a core part of their faith is shown to be true boosts; something shown to be doubtful dampens. 
* **Media Popularity:** Media ratings substantially rise (more people watch their shows) boosts; media ratings substantially fall (fewer people watch their shows) dampens. 

Ignore minor changes; only a special moment should cause a change.
Power Slider.short_effect:
Powers boosted or dampened based on criterion (Confidence/Faith/Media Popularity)
• Boosted: 2× range/duration, +1 damage multiplier, auto-Fantastic effects
• Dampened: ½ range/duration, -1 damage multiplier, no Fantastic success
• Lasts: 1 combat or 1 day

Precognition 1.name: Precognition 1
Precognition 1.description: The character can see the near future.
Precognition 1.effect: The character gains a sense of what is going to happen to a particular person, place, or item within their reach—including themselves—in the next 24 hours. The further out the future is, the harder it is to be certain, but they can sense broad paths. The player can ask the Narrator a single question about the day ahead and get an honest answer based on what is most likely to happen. The Narrator's answers should be short and direct, possibly cryptic, and do not dictate fate. The Narrator may also present unasked-for visions of vitally important, likely negative events, which still cost Focus.
Precognition 1.short_effect: Sense what will happen to person/place/item within Reach in next 24 hours

Precognition 2.name: Precognition 2
Precognition 2.description: The character can see the week ahead.
Precognition 2.effect: The character gains a sense of what is going to happen to a particular person, place, or item within their reach—including themselves—in the next week. Otherwise, this power works the same as Precognition 1. Alternatively, the character can consider the fate of something within one mile of their location (instead of within their reach) over the next 24 hours. The character must close their eyes and think about a thing they already know about.
Precognition 2.short_effect:
Sense next week of person/place/item within Reach; OR next 24h within 1 mile
Otherwise same as Precognition 1

Precognition 3.name: Precognition 3
Precognition 3.description: The character can see the month ahead.
Precognition 3.effect: The character gains a sense of what is going to happen to a particular person, place, or item within their reach—including themselves—in the next month. Otherwise, this power works the same as Precognition 1. Alternatively, the character can consider the fate of something within one mile of their location over the next week, or something within 100 miles of their location over the next 24 hours. The character must close their eyes and think about a thing they already know about.
Precognition 3.short_effect:
Sense next month within Reach; OR next week within 1 mile; OR next 24h within 100 miles
Otherwise same as Precognition 1

Precognition 4.name: Precognition 4
Precognition 4.description: The character can see a whole year ahead.
Precognition 4.effect: The character gains a sense of what is going to happen to a particular person, place, or item within their reach—including themselves—in the next year. Otherwise, this power works the same as Precognition 1. Alternatively, the character can consider the fate of something within one mile of their location over the next month, something within 100 miles over the next week, or something within 1,000 miles over the next 24 hours. The character must close their eyes and think about a thing they already know about.
Precognition 4.short_effect:
Sense next year within Reach; OR next month within 1 mile; OR next week within 100 miles; OR next 24h within 1,000 miles
Otherwise same as Precognition 1

Real Jinx.name: Real Jinx
Real Jinx.description: The character is bad luck—for their foes.
Real Jinx.effect: All characters who attempt to harm the character by direct action have trouble on their action checks. This does not stack with any other trouble.
Real Jinx.short_effect:
All who attempt to harm you by direct action have trouble
Does not stack

Restore.name: Restore
Restore.description: The character can heal a shattered mind.
Restore.effect: The character can bring a target back from being shattered. To attempt this, the character makes an Ego vs. TN 20 action check. On a success, the target is restored to 1 Focus. On a Fantastic success, the target is restored to full Focus. With any kind of success, the character using this power is then reduced to 1 Focus. On a failure, they only have to pay the minimum cost of 20 Focus.
Restore.short_effect:
Ego vs. TN 20 to restore shattered target
• Success: Target to 1 Focus (Fantastic: full Focus)
You reduced to 1 Focus on success

Resurrect.name: Resurrect
Resurrect.description: The character can help someone defy death.
Resurrect.effect: The character can try to bring a target back from the dead if done soon after the target's death. They must touch the dead target's body, and the body must be relatively intact. The character makes an Ego check against a TN equal to $10 + 1$ for every hour the target has been dead (e.g., 4 hours dead is TN 14). On a success, the target is restored to 1 Health. On a Fantastic success, the target is restored to full Health. With any kind of success, the character using this power is then reduced to 1 Focus. On a failure, they only have to pay the minimum cost of 20 Focus.
Resurrect.short_effect:
Touch dead target (relatively intact)
Ego vs. TN 10+1 per hour dead
• Success: Target to 1 Health (Fantastic: full Health)
You reduced to 1 Focus on success

Soothing Touch.name: Soothing Touch
Soothing Touch.description: The character can help get a friend's head back in the game.
Soothing Touch.effect: The character can restore a target creature's Focus with a touch. For every point of Focus the character spends, the target regains one point of Focus, up to their maximum score. The character must spend at least 10 Focus to use the power. Any Focus points that would have been restored beyond the target's maximum Focus are lost.
Soothing Touch.short_effect:
Touch target to restore Focus
1 Focus per Focus spent (10 Focus minimum)

Swap Items.name: Swap Items
Swap Items.description: The character swaps objects with someone else.
Swap Items.effect: The character swaps items they possess with the items of another person they can see within 2 spaces per the character's rank. These items can include weapons, clothing, or anything else that is on the other person but not attached to them. When the effect ends, the swapped items return to the people who had them originally. The character can swap all of their possessions or be selective. The items must generally be swapped on an equal basis, but swapping something for nothing is possible (e.g., swapping nothing held for a target's pistol). If the person being swapped with is unwilling, the character must make an Ego check against that person's Vigilance defense to succeed.
Swap Items.short_effect:
Swap your possessions with target's items (visible, 2 spaces/rank)
Can be selective or swap all; can swap nothing for something
Unwilling target requires Ego vs. Vigilance
Revert when effect ends

Charmed Life.name: Charmed Life
Charmed Life.description: The character seems like they were born lucky.
Charmed Life.effect: The character gains an edge on any single action check each round. This does not stack with any other edges.
Charmed Life.short_effect:
Edge on one action check per round
Does not stack

Copy Psyche.name: Copy Psyche
Copy Psyche.description: The character can move whole minds around.
Copy Psyche.effect: The character can copy the mind of a person with whom they have established a telepathic link and store it in their own mind. They can also transmit a mind (theirs or a stored copy) into another person's mind with whom they have a telepathic link. Additionally, it can be used to erase a copied mind from a person's brain. A character can hold up to one extra mind for every rank. Stored minds can converse with and try to influence the character. Mind Reading can be used on stored guest minds without establishing a telepathic link. Having more than one extra mind requires a daily Resilience vs. TN 9 check; failure costs 5 Focus that cannot be regained until extra minds are removed, leading to the character becoming demoralized eventually. Removing an extra mind requires a Logic check against the mind's Logic defense; success permanently deletes the mind, failure costs 5 Focus. If the character is demoralized, a mind inside them can attempt a Logic check against the character's Logic defense to take over the body (Fantastic success fully restores Focus). To place a mind in an unwilling target, the target must first be demoralized, and the character must succeed on a Logic check against the target's Logic defense (Fantastic success results in a takeover with Focus fully restored). An original mind whose body is taken over remains and can try to take over again if the new controller becomes demoralized. If the character is shattered, all extra minds are permanently lost. Can be used with Cerebro protocols to resurrect a character by transmitting their stored mind copy into a fresh clone.
Copy Psyche.short_effect:
Copy mind from telepathic link target (store 1 per rank)
Transmit stored/your mind into linked target
Stored minds can converse and influence you
>1 extra mind: Daily Resilience TN 9 or lose 5 Focus (leads to demoralized)
Remove mind: Logic vs. mind's Logic (deletes permanently)
Place in unwilling: Target demoralized, Logic vs. Logic (Fantastic: takeover with full Focus)

Cosmic Awareness.name: Cosmic Awareness
Cosmic Awareness.description: The character can detect details about things anywhere in the universe.
Cosmic Awareness.effect: The character can sense selected things at any distance, as long as they are in the same universe. This includes the location, relative velocity, and overall emotional and physical status of any item, creature, or group known to the character.
Cosmic Awareness.short_effect: Sense selected things at any distance (same universe): location, velocity, status

Cure-All.name: Cure-All
Cure-All.description: The character can cure what ails you-mostly.
Cure-All.effect: With a touch, the character can cure any temporary ailments a target suffers from. The character makes an Ego vs. TN 11 action check. On a success, the ailment's effects end immediately. On a Fantastic success, treat the result like a recovery check, and the target gains back that much Health and Focus lost to the condition. Affects conditions like ablaze, bleeding, blinded, corroding, deafened, demoralized, paralyzed, poisoned, and unconscious. If demoralized, target gains 1 Focus; if unconscious, target gains 1 Health (more on Fantastic success). Only works on acute conditions/diseases that would resolve soon; does not affect chronic, permanent, serious, or likely fatal diseases, including the Techno-Organic, Transmode, or Legacy viruses.
Cure-All.short_effect:
Touch target: Ego vs. TN 11
• Success: End ailment immediately
• Fantastic: Recovery check, gain Health/Focus back
Affects temporary conditions (ablaze, bleeding, blinded, etc.)
Not chronic/serious diseases

Danger Sense.name: Danger Sense
Danger Sense.description: The character can feel danger on the way.
Danger Sense.effect: Even without a Fantastic result on their initiative check, the character gets a turn during the bonus round of any combat they are in. This works even if no one else can act in the bonus round.
Danger Sense.short_effect: Always get turn in bonus round (even without Fantastic initiative)

Detect Lie.name: Detect Lie
Detect Lie.description: The character can tell if you're telling the truth.
Detect Lie.trigger: Verbal communication the character can understand
Detect Lie.effect: When someone communicates in a form the character can understand (verbally, telepathically, sign language, etc.), the character makes an Ego check against the communicator's Ego defense. On a success, the character knows if the communicator is lying. On a Fantastic success, they also know why (if possible). This only works on communicators who know they are lying; if they believe what they're saying, no lie is detected.
Detect Lie.short_effect:
Ego vs. Ego defense when someone communicates
• Success: Know if lying
• Fantastic: Also know why
Only detects if communicator knows they're lying

Detect Supers.name: Detect Supers
Detect Supers.description: The character can sense super-powered people.
Detect Supers.effect: The character can sense anyone within range who has super-powers. Reveals a count of the number of people with powers and their rough distance and direction. Does not reveal other information like name, appearance, or type of powers. Powers picked by someone with the Special Training origin are not considered super-powers. When picking this power, the character must choose between the regular power (4-mile range) or a limited power (25-mile range) that detects powers from only a single origin (like Mutant or Alien).
Detect Supers.short_effect: Sense powered people within range: count, rough distance/direction

Evil Eye.name: Evil Eye
Evil Eye.description: The character can inflict trouble on those who cross their path.
Evil Eye.effect: The character picks a foe in their line of sight. That foe has trouble on all action checks made for the power's duration. There is no limit on the range once the power is activated. The Focus cost must be paid at the start of each subsequent turn to maintain concentration.
Evil Eye.short_effect:
Foe in line of sight has trouble on all checks
Pay Focus at start of each turn to maintain

Healing Hands.name: Healing Hands
Healing Hands.description: The character has a healing touch.
Healing Hands.effect: The character can heal a target creature with a touch. For every point of Focus the character spends (minimum 9 Focus), the target regains a point of Health, up to their maximum score. Any healing beyond the target's maximum Health is lost.
Healing Hands.short_effect:
Touch target to heal
1 Health per Focus spent (9 Focus minimum)

Indecipherable.name: Indecipherable
Indecipherable.description: The character has a language all their own.
Indecipherable.effect: The character has constructed an internal language that only they can understand and think in. They translate from this language when communicating. This effectively renders them immune to telepathic powers like Mind Reading or Mind Interrogation, as anyone trying to read their mind cannot understand the unique language.
Indecipherable.short_effect:
Think in unique internal language
Immune to Mind Reading/Interrogation

Intuition.name: Intuition
Intuition.description: The character has a bad feeling about this.
Intuition.effect: When faced with a decision, the character can get a feeling about which choice would be best for them in the long run. The player presents the choice to the Narrator, who tells them which choice the intuition is leading toward. What is best for the character may not be best for others or for the short term.
Intuition.short_effect:
Get feeling about which choice is best for you long-term
Narrator tells you which choice

Jinx You.name: Jinx You
Jinx You.description: The character can hit you with a jinx.
Jinx You.effect: The character makes a Melee check to target. On a success, the target has trouble on all action checks made for the power's duration. On a Fantastic success, the target also takes standard Melee damage. The Focus cost must be paid at the start of each subsequent turn to maintain concentration.
Jinx You.short_effect:
Melee check vs. target within reach (4 Focus/turn)
• Success: Target has trouble on all action checks
• Fantastic: Target also takes standard Melee damage

Jinx You All.name: Jinx You All
Jinx You All.description: The character can jinx a whole group of foes at once.
Jinx You All.effect: The character picks up to one foe per rank in line of sight. Those foes have trouble on all action checks made for the power's duration. There is no limit on the range once the power is activated. The Focus cost must be paid at the start of each subsequent turn to maintain concentration.
Jinx You All.short_effect:
Foes (1 per rank) in line of sight have trouble on all checks
Pay Focus at start of each turn to maintain

Let's Go.name: Let's Go
Let's Go.description: The character can get a friend back on their feet.
Let's Go.effect: The character can eliminate the effects of a target losing all of their Health. Instead of falling unconscious, the target remains awake and mobile. They can use movement actions but not reactions or standard actions. This does not protect a character from death or bring back a dead character. Once the power takes effect, the target does not have to remain within reach. When the effect ends, if the target has -1 Health or less, they become unconscious. The power automatically ends if the target's Health rises above 0.
Let's Go.short_effect:
Target within reach at -1 Health remains awake/mobile (movement only, no reactions/standard actions)
Not protected from death
Ends when Health >0 or effect ends (then unconscious if still ≤-1)

Lucky Me.name: Lucky Me
Lucky Me.description: Things are about to go the character's way.
Lucky Me.effect: The character gains an edge on all action checks made while this power is in effect. The Focus cost must be paid at the start of each subsequent turn to maintain concentration.
Lucky Me.short_effect:
Edge on all your checks
Pay Focus at start of each turn to maintain

Lucky Us.name: Lucky Us
Lucky Us.description: The character can share their good fortune with many friends.
Lucky Us.effect: The character picks up to one ally in their line of sight per the character's rank. The character and those allies gain an edge on all action checks made while this power is in effect. There is no limit on the range once the power is activated. The Focus cost must be paid at the start of each subsequent turn to maintain concentration.
Lucky Us.short_effect:
You + allies (1 per rank) in line of sight gain edge on all checks
Pay Focus at start of each turn to maintain

Lucky You.name: Lucky You
Lucky You.description: The character can give good fortune to a friend.
Lucky You.effect: The character touches an ally. That ally gains an edge on all action checks made while this power is in effect.
Lucky You.short_effect: Touched ally gains edge on all checks

Microscopic Awareness.name: Microscopic Awareness
Microscopic Awareness.description: The character can detect details about the smallest things.
Microscopic Awareness.effect: The character can see and identify items that would normally require a microscope to detect, such as fingerprints, a single strand of hair, and a person's DNA. The character can use DNA to identify a person and link them to close relatives.
Microscopic Awareness.short_effect: See and identify microscopic items (fingerprints, DNA, etc.) within 0 spaces per rank while concentrating

Accuracy 1.name: Accuracy 1
Accuracy 1.description: The character is an ace with ranged attacks.
Accuracy 1.effect: The character adds +1 to their Agility damage multiplier, and they gain a +1 bonus to Agility checks other than attacks.
Accuracy 1.short_effect: +1 Agility damage multiplier; +1 to non-attack Agility checks

Accuracy 2.name: Accuracy 2
Accuracy 2.effect: The character adds +2 to their Agility damage multiplier, and they gain a +2 bonus to Agility checks other than attacks.
Accuracy 2.short_effect: +2 Agility damage multiplier; +2 to non-attack Agility checks

Accuracy 3.name: Accuracy 3
Accuracy 3.description: The character could hit a fly at one hundred paces.
Accuracy 3.effect: The character adds +3 to their Agility damage multiplier, and they gain a +3 bonus to Agility checks other than attacks.
Accuracy 3.short_effect: +3 Agility damage multiplier; +3 to non-attack Agility checks

Accuracy 4.name: Accuracy 4
Accuracy 4.description: The character can out-target almost anyone.
Accuracy 4.effect: The character adds +4 to their Agility damage multiplier, and they gain a +4 bonus to Agility checks other than attacks.
Accuracy 4.short_effect: +4 Agility damage multiplier; +4 to non-attack Agility checks

Additional Limbs.name: Additional Limbs
Additional Limbs.description: The character has extra limbs that can grab objects and attack foes.
Additional Limbs.effect: The character has an additional prehensile appendage (like a tail) or a symmetrical pair of them (like arms) that can be used to lift objects, use tools or otherwise take actions that normally require the use of a hand. This grants them an edge in Melee and Agility checks. A character can have as many additional limbs as they like-within reason-but they get no additional advantages for them.
Additional Limbs.short_effect: Extra prehensile limb(s) grant edge on Melee and Agility checks

Advance.name: Advance
Advance.description: The character can advance their allies on the battlefield.
Advance.trigger: The character (or an ally in line of sight) stuns or defeats an enemy.
Advance.effect: Any allies in earshot can be affected, up to a number equal to the character's Ego defense. Each affected ally can immediately use a free movement action to move toward the enemy that triggered the reaction.
Advance.short_effect: Reaction: Allies in earshot (up to Ego defense) can move toward triggering enemy

Always Ready.name: Always Ready
Always Ready.description: The character is prepared to fight.
Always Ready.effect: The character gains one additional reaction per round, which can be used only to activate a Martial Arts power.
Always Ready.short_effect: +1 reaction per round (can only use for Martial Arts powers)

Anger.name: Anger
Anger.description: You won't like them when they're angry.
Anger.trigger: The character is harmed by an attack.
Anger.effect: The character becomes angry and uses that anger to increase their strength. For every 10 points of Focus they spend, they add +15 to their Melee damage bonus and lose -2 from their Logic-and subsequently their Logic defense. While using this power, they cannot use any other powers that require concentration.
Anger.short_effect:
Per 10 Focus spent: +15 Melee damage, -2 Logic/Logic defense
Cannot use other concentration powers while angry

Animal Bond.name: Animal Bond
Animal Bond.description: The character can communicate with an animal friend.
Animal Bond.effect: The character can communicate telepathically with one animal of their choice, and they must have befriended the animal before. They cannot switch to another animal unless the animal dies, but they can select this power multiple times if desired. The communication can be verbal, visual or even more complex, such as imparting location information. There is no limit to the distance of the communication, as long as the character and the animal are in the same dimension. Animals with a telepathic bond are generally willing to communicate, even if they aren't friendly. Bonded animals often do whatever the character asks, even if it might put them in danger.
Animal Bond.short_effect:
Communicate telepathically with one befriended animal (any distance, same dimension)
Cannot switch to another

Animal Communication.name: Animal Communication
Animal Communication.description: The character can communicate with a type of animal.
Animal Communication.effect: The character can communicate telepathically with one taxonomic order of animals, such as birds, mammals, fish, amphibians and so on. They can call out to them as a group up to 500 spaces per rank away, and they can communicate specifically with ones they have met or at least seen. They cannot switch to another taxonomic order, but they can select this power multiple times if desired. The communication with the animals can be verbal, visual or even more complex, such as imparting location information. There is no limit to the distance of the communication, as long as the character and the animals are in the same dimension. Friendly animals often do whatever the character asks, as long as it doesn't put them in danger-and they may be willing to risk even that for one they consider a friend. Hostile animals simply ignore all such requests-which make them a poor choice for communication.
Animal Communication.short_effect:
Communicate telepathically with one taxonomic order of animals
Can call out to specific animal (10 spaces/rank) or summon rank animals

Animated Illusion.name: Animated Illusion
Animated Illusion.description: By manipulating visual light, the character creates a moving hologram.
Animated Illusion.effect: The character creates a visual-only illusion anywhere in line of sight, within 50 spaces. The illusion can be anything up to four sizes larger than the character, and it can move freely within its limits. The character breaks concentration if they move beyond 50 spaces from the illusion or lose line of sight to it.
Animated Illusion.short_effect:
Visual illusion (line of sight, 50 spaces, +4 sizes)
Moves freely, obeys commands
See through: Vigilance vs. your Ego
Damage/concentration breaks it

Astral Form.name: Astral Form
Astral Form.description: The character can enter the Astral Plane.
Astral Form.effect: The character can project an avatar into the Astral Plane, leaving their physical body in a deep trance in the real world, where it is vulnerable to attack. While in the Astral Plane, they can interact with other characters in the Astral Plane, but they are intangible, invisible and generally undetectable in the real world. However, they can sense things in the real world. If the character is Rank 4 or higher, they can also take on a transparent form that can be seen in the real world. While in the Astral Plane, the character can fly, and in combat, their Flight Speed is equal to their rank times their Run Speed. Outside of combat, they can move 10 times as fast.
Astral Form.short_effect:
Project avatar into Astral Plane (body vulnerable in trance)
Fly at rank × Run Speed (10× outside combat)
Rank 4+: Can be seen by normal people

Attack Stance.name: Attack Stance
Attack Stance.description: The character enters an aggressive attack stance, ready to strike in any direction.
Attack Stance.effect: The character doubles their Melee ability bonus to damage.
Attack Stance.short_effect: Double Melee ability bonus to damage

Banging Heads.name: Banging Heads
Banging Heads.description: The character takes two nearby enemies and slams their heads into each other.
Banging Heads.effect: The character makes one Melee check against the Melee defense scores of two enemies within reach. If the attack fails against either foe, it fails entirely. If the attack is a success against both foes, each enemy takes full damage. On a Fantastic success, each enemy is also knocked prone.
Banging Heads.short_effect:
Melee check vs. two enemies within reach (fails if either defense beats it)
• Success: Both take full damage
• Fantastic: Both take full damage and knocked prone

Battle Plan.name: Battle Plan
Battle Plan.description: The character always has a plan.
Battle Plan.effect: The character inspires one or more allies of their choice in earshot, up to the character's Vigilance. Inspired allies gain an edge on all action checks until the start of the character's next turn.
Battle Plan.short_effect: Allies in earshot (up to Vigilance) gain edge on all checks until start of your next turn

Blazing-Fast Fists.name: Blazing-Fast Fists
Blazing-Fast Fists.effect: The character has an edge on all Melee attacks.

Blink.name: Blink
Blink.description: The character teleports a short distance away.
Blink.effect: The character teleports into a clear space they can see or have been to, up to their rank in spaces away. If someone was about to attack them and they are now out of reach or line of sight, the attack automatically fails. If they are still within reach or line of sight, the attack has trouble instead.
Blink.short_effect:
Teleport to visible/known clear space (up to rank spaces)
Attacker auto-fails if now out of reach/sight, or has trouble if partially blocked

Blink Barrage.name: Blink Barrage
Blink Barrage.description: The character teleports rapidly around an opponent.
Blink Barrage.effect: The character teleports several times in quick succession and winds up in a clear space they can see or have been to, up to their rank in spaces away. Any attacks have trouble against them for one round.
Blink Barrage.short_effect:
Teleport rapidly to visible/known space (up to rank spaces)
Attacks have trouble against you for 1 round

Blink Defense.name: Blink Defense
Blink Defense.description: The character teleports a short distance away.
Blink Defense.trigger: The character or an ally within reach is the subject of a ranged attack.
Blink Defense.effect: The character pops away just as the attack reaches them and then pops back into the same space, leaving the projectile behind. The character makes an Ego check with an edge against the attacker's Agility check result. On a success, the projectile from the attack is teleported away, someplace safe. On a Fantastic success, the attack is turned against the attacker, using the Ego check the character just made as the attack check.
Blink Defense.short_effect:
Ego check with edge vs. attacker's Agility defense (reaction vs. ranged attack)
• Success: Teleport projectile away safely
• Fantastic: Redirect attack at attacker (use your Ego check as attack roll)

Blur.name: Blur
Blur.description: The character moves like a blur!
Blur.effect: Any attacks against the character have trouble.
Blur.short_effect: All attacks against you have trouble for 1 round

Body Sheet.name: Body Sheet
Body Sheet.description: The character can flatten themselves like a sheet.
Body Sheet.trigger: The character falls or is the target of an attack.
Body Sheet.effect: The character gains Health Damage Reduction 3, but they cannot make attacks. They gain a Glide Speed equal to double their Run Speed.
Body Sheet.short_effect: Health Damage Reduction 3; cannot attack; Glide Speed = 2× Run Speed

Body Sphere.name: Body Sphere
Body Sphere.description: The character can form their body into a protective sphere.
Body Sphere.trigger: The character or an ally is the target of an attack.
Body Sphere.effect: The character forms their body into a sphere, protecting up to one ally per rank, squeezed into the same space. Those inside the sphere gain Health Damage Reduction 3 against outside attacks, but they cannot move on their own until the character releases them. Alternatively, if the attacker is within the character's reach, the character can make an Agility check against the target's Agility defense. On a success, the character envelops the attacker, grabbing them. On a Fantastic success, the character closes the sphere enough to pin the attacker too.
Body Sphere.short_effect:
Form sphere protecting allies (1 per rank) with Health Damage Reduction 3
OR reaction vs. attacker in reach:
• Success: Envelop and grab attacker
• Fantastic: Also pin attacker

Bolts of Balthakk.name: Bolts of Balthakk
Bolts of Balthakk.description: The character fires enchanted bolts of electricity from their fingers.
Bolts of Balthakk.effect: The character makes an Ego check with an edge against the Agility defense of a target in their line of sight. For this attack, add +1 to the character's Agility damage bonus for every 2 points of Focus they spend. On a success, an affected target takes that total damage. On a Fantastic success, an affected target takes double that total damage and is stunned for one round.
Bolts of Balthakk.short_effect:
Ego check with edge vs. Agility defense (line of sight)
+1 Agility damage per 2 Focus spent
• Success: Target takes damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and stunned for 1 round

Boost Powers.name: Boost Powers
Boost Powers.description: The character turbocharges all of another character's powers!
Boost Powers.effect: The character picks one character within 5 spaces and boosts all of their powers. If the powers have ranges or effective areas or durations, these are doubled. If the powers affect a damage multiplier, add 1 to the effects. Any effects that normally happen with a Fantastic successes automatically happen on any success, not just a Fantastic one. If the target's powers have costs, the character must pay the highest of them or a minimum of 15 Focus.
Boost Powers.short_effect:
Target within 5 spaces: Boost all their powers
• 2× ranges/areas/durations
• +1 damage multiplier
• Fantastic effects on any success
• Cost: 15 Focus + 5 per rank above 1

Borrow Senses.name: Borrow Senses
Borrow Senses.description: The character can use another person's senses.
Borrow Senses.effect: The character can use the full senses of someone or something with whom they have established a telepathic link or bond. While they do, they retain the use of their own senses too.
Borrow Senses.short_effect:
Use full senses of telepathic link/bond target (retain your awareness)
Ego vs. Vigilance to force

Bounce Back.name: Bounce Back
Bounce Back.description: The character bounces back from even the hardest falls.
Bounce Back.trigger: The character takes damage from a fall or is knocked prone.
Bounce Back.effect: The fall doesn't damage the character. If they are prone, they stand up. If they'd like, they can also jump a number of spaces, up to their Run Speed.
Bounce Back.short_effect: Reaction when falling: Negate fall damage, stand up, optionally jump up to Run Speed

Brace for Impact.name: Brace for Impact
Brace for Impact.description: The character mentally toughens themselves for a fight.
Brace for Impact.trigger: An enemy deals physical damage to the character.
Brace for Impact.effect: For every point of Focus spent, the character can ignore 1 point of Health damage dealt by the attack.
Brace for Impact.short_effect: Ignore 1 Health damage per Focus spent (reaction vs. attack)

Brain Drain.name: Brain Drain
Brain Drain.description: The character consumes the energies of another.
Brain Drain.effect: The character makes an Ego attack against the target's Vigilance. If it succeeds, the target takes regular Focus damage, and the character heals half that much Focus for themselves. On a Fantastic success, the character heals their full Focus damage instead.
Brain Drain.short_effect:
Ego vs. Vigilance (reaction vs. grabbed target)
• Success: Target takes Focus damage, heal half that Focus
• Fantastic: Heal full Focus damage dealt

Brawling.name: Brawling
Brawling.description: The character has the moves and is hard to hit.
Brawling.effect: The character can use their Melee defense score against Agility attacks too.
Brawling.short_effect: Use Melee defense vs. Agility attacks

Brilliance 1.name: Brilliance 1
Brilliance 1.description: The character puts their brain to work.
Brilliance 1.effect: The character adds +1 to their Logic damage multiplier, and they gain a +1 bonus to Logic checks other than attacks.
Brilliance 1.short_effect: +1 Logic damage multiplier; +1 to non-attack Logic checks

Brilliance 2.name: Brilliance 2
Brilliance 2.description: Everything makes more sense to the character.
Brilliance 2.effect: The character adds +2 to their Logic damage multiplier, and they gain a +2 bonus to Logic checks other than attacks.
Brilliance 2.short_effect: +2 Logic damage multiplier; +2 to non-attack Logic checks

Brilliance 3.name: Brilliance 3
Brilliance 3.description: Little can stop the character's mind.
Brilliance 3.effect: The character adds +3 to their Logic damage multiplier, and they gain a +3 bonus to Logic checks other than attacks.
Brilliance 3.short_effect: +3 Logic damage multiplier; +3 to non-attack Logic checks

Brilliance 4.name: Brilliance 4
Brilliance 4.effect: The character adds +4 to their Logic damage multiplier, and they gain a +4 bonus to Logic checks other than attacks.
Brilliance 4.short_effect: +4 Logic damage multiplier; +4 to non-attack Logic checks

Bump Power.name: Bump Power
Bump Power.description: The character bumps up another character's power.
Bump Power.effect: The character picks one power from another character within 5 spaces and boosts it. If the power has ranges or effective areas or durations, these are doubled. If the power affects a damage multiplier, add 1 to the effect. Any effects that normally happen with a Fantastic success automatically happen on any success, not just a Fantastic one. If the power has a cost, the character must pay it as well, with a minimum of 5 Focus.
Bump Power.short_effect:
Boost one target power (within 5 spaces)
• 2× range/area/duration
• +1 damage multiplier
• Fantastic effects on any success
• Cost: Power's cost (5 Focus minimum)

Catch Bullets.name: Catch Bullets
Catch Bullets.description: The character is fast enough to catch bullets-safely!
Catch Bullets.trigger: A ranged attack using physical projectiles (arrows, bullets and so on) is made against the character-or a character within their character's reach.
Catch Bullets.effect: The character makes an Agility check, using the attacker's attack result as the target number. If the character's check succeeds, the attack is nullified. On a Fantastic success, the character gets their reaction back.
Catch Bullets.short_effect:
Agility check vs. attacker's result (reaction vs. ranged attack)
• Success: Nullify attack
• Fantastic: Nullify attack and regain reaction

Chain Strikes.name: Chain Strikes
Chain Strikes.description: The character unleashes a hail of strikes.
Chain Strikes.effect: The character makes a close attack with an edge. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the character can also make an additional Chain Strike.
Chain Strikes.short_effect:
Close attack with edge
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: Regular damage and make another Chain Strike

Change of Plans.name: Change of Plans
Change of Plans.description: The character thinks of a better way.
Change of Plans.trigger: An ally has trouble on an action check.
Change of Plans.effect: The ally gains an edge on that action check.
Change of Plans.short_effect: Ally gains edge on that action check

Cloak.name: Cloak
Cloak.description: The character makes people believe they're not there.
Cloak.effect: The character uses a mirage to block their presence from the minds of people within 20 spaces per rank. Cameras (for instance) can still record them, but when people look in the character's direction, they see nothing there. The target number for anyone trying to detect the character is the character's Logic defense.
Cloak.short_effect:
Block your presence from minds (20 spaces/rank)
Cameras still record you
Detect TN = your Logic defense

Cloak Group.name: Cloak Group
Cloak Group.description: The character mentally hides themselves and their friends.
Cloak Group.effect: Using a mirage, the character blocks their presence-and the presence of up to one other person per rank, within 10 spaces-from the minds of people within 20 spaces per rank. Cameras (for instance) can still record them, but when people look in the characters' direction, they see nothing there. The target number for anyone trying to detect the character or the others protected is the character's Logic defense.
Cloak Group.short_effect:
Block presence of you + allies (1 per rank, within 10 spaces) from minds (20 spaces/rank)
Cameras still record
Detect TN = your Logic defense

Clobber.name: Clobber
Clobber.description: The character pummels their foe with enough force to knock them flat.
Clobber.effect: The character makes a close attack against an enemy. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage and is knocked prone.
Clobber.short_effect:
Close attack
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and knocked prone

Clone Moves.name: Clone Moves
Clone Moves.description: The character duplicates another character's combat moves.
Clone Moves.effect: The character picks another character within 10 spaces and in their line of sight and duplicates all their powers that could be selected with the Special Training origin. They can now use those powers as if they were always theirs. If the copied powers have costs, the character must pay the highest of them, or a minimum of 5 Focus. When the character uses a copied power, they must pay any cost normally as well.
Clone Moves.short_effect:
Duplicate target's Special Training powers (10 spaces, line of sight)
• Cost: Highest power cost or 5 Focus minimum
• Use copied powers normally (paying costs)

Clone Powers.name: Clone Powers
Clone Powers.description: The character duplicates all of another character's powers.
Clone Powers.effect: The character picks another character within 10 spaces and duplicates all of their powers. They can now use those powers as if they were always theirs. If the target's powers have costs, the character must pay the highest of them, or a minimum of 15 Focus. When the character uses a copied power, they must pay any cost normally as well.
Clone Powers.short_effect:
Duplicate all target powers (10 spaces)
• Cost: Highest power cost or 15 Focus minimum
• Use copied powers normally (paying costs)

Coiling Crush.name: Coiling Crush
Coiling Crush.description: The character wraps around a target and crushes it.
Coiling Crush.effect: The character makes a Melee attack. On a success, the enemy is paralyzed. On a Fantastic success, the enemy also takes regular damage. During the character's subsequent turns, they can spend their movement action to make a Melee check against the enemy's Resilience. If this succeeds, they inflict regular Health damage. On a Fantastic success, they do double damage instead. During the paralyzed enemy's turn, they can make a Melee check against the character's Melee defense to break free.
Coiling Crush.short_effect:
Melee attack (reaction vs. grabbed enemy)
• Success: Paralyze enemy
• Fantastic: Paralyze and deal damage
• Each turn: Use movement to deal damage (Melee vs. Resilience)
• Enemy: Melee vs. your Melee defense to break free

Combat Support.name: Combat Support
Combat Support.description: The character gives a friend a hand.
Combat Support.effect: Once per battle, the character chooses an ally in earshot. If the ally makes an action check before the start of the character's next turn, the ally automatically rolls a 1 on their Marvel die, and that die cannot be affected by trouble.
Combat Support.short_effect: Once per battle: Ally in earshot auto-rolls 1 on Marvel die (unaffected by trouble) before start of your next turn

Combat Trickery.name: Combat Trickery
Combat Trickery.description: The character is a tricky one!
Combat Trickery.effect: Once per battle, when the character is attacking targets of equal or higher rank, the character automatically rolls a 1 on their Marvel die, and that die cannot be affected by trouble. If the character is attacking multiple targets, all the targets must be of equal or higher rank.
Combat Trickery.short_effect: Once per battle vs. equal/higher rank: Auto-roll 1 on Marvel die (unaffected by trouble)

Command.name: Command
Command.description: The character forces someone to follow an order.
Command.effect: The character gives an order to a target with whom they've established a Telepathic Link. The character makes a Logic check against the target's Logic defense. On a success, the target complies with the order. On a Fantastic success, the character gains an edge the next time they use this power against this same target. The command must be something that can be completed in a single action. If it involves harming someone, the character has trouble on the check. If it would cause the target to harm themselves, the character has double trouble on the check.
Command.short_effect:
Logic vs. Logic (telepathic link target)
• Success: Target obeys 1-action command (Fantastic: edge next time)
Harm someone: Trouble; harm self: Double trouble

Control Fog.name: Control Fog
Control Fog.description: The character can create or dispel a thick fog.
Control Fog.effect: The character creates a thick fog for up to 50 spaces per rank around them that blocks all line of sight beyond 10 spaces. They can also dispel any fog in a similar area.
Control Fog.short_effect:
Create fog (50 spaces/rank) blocking line of sight beyond 10 spaces
Can dispel fog

Control Weather 1.name: Control Weather 1
Control Weather 1.description: The character can make it rain.
Control Weather 1.effect: It starts to rain in an area up to 5 miles across times the character's rank, centered on the character. All ranges are cut in half. Movement is not affected.
Control Weather 1.short_effect: Rain (5 miles × rank); all ranges halved; movement not affected

Control Weather 2.name: Control Weather 2
Control Weather 2.description: The character can make it storm.
Control Weather 2.effect: It starts to storm in an area up to 5 miles across times the character's rank, centered on the character. All ranges and all speeds are cut in half.
Control Weather 2.short_effect: Storm (5 miles × rank); all ranges and speeds halved

Control Weather 3.name: Control Weather 3
Control Weather 3.effect: It starts to storm in an area up to 5 miles across times the character's rank, centered on the character. All ranges and all speeds are cut in half. If the character also has the Elemental Blast (Electricity) power, they can use it as a reaction when attacked while this power is active.
Control Weather 3.short_effect: Thunderstorm (5 miles × rank); all ranges/speeds halved; use Elemental Blast (Electricity) as reaction if you have it

Control Weather 4.name: Control Weather 4
Control Weather 4.effect: It starts to storm in an area up to 5 miles across times the character's rank, centered on the character. All ranges and all speeds are cut to one quarter normal, and flying is impossible. If the character also has the Elemental Barrage (Electricity) power, they can use it as a reaction when attacked while this power is active.
Control Weather 4.short_effect: Hurricane (5 miles × rank); ranges/speeds quartered, no flying; use Elemental Barrage (Electricity) as reaction if you have it

Copy Ability.name: Copy Ability
Copy Ability.description: The character duplicates another character's ability.
Copy Ability.effect: The character picks one ability score of another character within 10 spaces and duplicates it. They now use that ability score in place of their own.
Copy Ability.short_effect:
Duplicate one ability score from target (10 spaces)
Use theirs in place of yours

Copy Power.name: Copy Power
Copy Power.description: The character duplicates another character's power.
Copy Power.effect: The character picks one power a target within 10 spaces has and duplicates it. They can now use it as if it was always theirs. When the character uses such a power, they must pay any cost normally as well.
Copy Power.short_effect:
Duplicate one power from target (10 spaces)
Use as if always yours (pay costs)

Copy Trait.name: Copy Trait
Copy Trait.description: The character duplicates another character's trait.
Copy Trait.effect: The character picks one trait another character within 10 spaces has and duplicates it. They can now use it as if it was always theirs.
Copy Trait.short_effect:
Duplicate one trait from target (10 spaces)
Use as if always yours

Counterstrike Technique.name: Counterstrike Technique
Counterstrike Technique.description: The character counters an enemy's strike with one of their own.
Counterstrike Technique.trigger: While Attack Stance is active, a close attack against the character does damage.
Counterstrike Technique.effect: The character deals half the attacker's regular damage to the attacker.
Counterstrike Technique.short_effect: Reaction while Attack Stance active: Deal half attacker's damage back to attacker

Covering Fire.name: Covering Fire
Covering Fire.description: The character covers an ally's attack.
Covering Fire.trigger: An ally within the character's line of sight begins its turn.
Covering Fire.effect: The character makes an Agility attack against a target's Vigilance defense. If the attack is a success, apply Health Damage Reduction normally. The target takes any damage to their Focus. If it's a Fantastic success, the damage is doubled, and if the target takes any Focus damage, they are stunned for one round.
Covering Fire.short_effect:
Agility vs. Vigilance (reaction to protect ally)
• Success: Damage goes to ally's Focus instead of Health
• Fantastic: 2× damage to Focus and stunned for 1 round

Crimson Bands of Cyttorak.name: Crimson Bands of Cyttorak
Crimson Bands of Cyttorak.description: The character unleashes red bands of magic that lash out to capture their target.
Crimson Bands of Cyttorak.effect: The character makes an Ego check with an edge against the Melee defense of a target in their line of sight. If the attack is a success, the crimson bands paralyze the target. On a Fantastic success, the target can be pinned too. Breaking out of the crimson bands requires a Melee check with target number 20.
Crimson Bands of Cyttorak.short_effect:
Ego vs. Melee with edge (line of sight, 20 spaces)
• Success: Paralyze target
• Fantastic: Paralyze and pin target
• Escape: Melee check TN 20

Crushing Grip.name: Crushing Grip
Crushing Grip.description: The character seizes an enemy and squeezes hard.
Crushing Grip.effect: The character makes a Melee attack against the grabbed target's Resilience defense. If it's a success, the target takes regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the target takes double damage instead and is pinned.
Crushing Grip.short_effect:
Melee vs. Resilience (reaction vs. grabbed target)
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and pin

Dampen Power.name: Dampen Power
Dampen Power.description: The character tamps down another character's power.
Dampen Power.effect: The character picks one power from another character within 20 spaces and makes an Ego attack against them. On a success, they tamp the power down. If the power has ranges or effective areas or durations, these are halved. If the power affects a damage multiplier, subtract 1 from the effect. The power can no longer enjoy Fantastic successes. If the power has a Focus cost, the character must also pay that cost to dampen it.
Dampen Power.short_effect:
Ego attack vs. target within 20 spaces
• Success: Target power dampened (½ range/area/duration, -1 damage multiplier, no Fantastic success)
• Cost: Target power's Focus cost

Dance of Death.name: Dance of Death
Dance of Death.description: The character spins about, shooting at every enemy around them.
Dance of Death.effect: The character makes an Agility check and compares that against the Agility defense of every enemy within 10 spaces and in their line of sight. Each success does half the regular damage. On a Fantastic success, each enemy takes full damage instead and is bleeding.
Dance of Death.short_effect:
Agility vs. all enemies within 10 spaces (line of sight)
• Success: Each enemy takes ½ damage
• Fantastic: Each enemy takes full damage and bleeding

Darkness.name: Darkness
Darkness.description: The targets become shrouded in unnatural darkness.
Darkness.effect: An area up to 5 spaces wide per the character's rank-centered on anything the character wishes, within 50 spaces-is filled with inky darkness. Those inside it cannot see anything, and no lights work within it except those generated by powers. The character must remain within 50 spaces of the affected area to avoid breaking concentration.
Darkness.short_effect:
Inky darkness (5 spaces/rank wide, within 50 spaces)
No vision except power-generated lights
Must stay within 50 spaces to maintain

Dazzle.name: Dazzle
Dazzle.description: The character blasts a blinding light into the face of their foe.
Dazzle.effect: The character makes an Ego check against an enemy in their line of sight and compares that against the target's Vigilance defense. If the attack is a success, the enemy is blinded for 1 turn. On a Fantastic success, it also inflicts regular damage. Alternatively, the character can blind the victim with darkness.
Dazzle.short_effect:
Ego vs. Vigilance (line of sight, 20 spaces)
• Success: Blind target for 1 turn
• Fantastic: Blind for 1 turn and deal damage

Deafen.name: Deafen
Deafen.description: The character slaps silence into the target's ears.
Deafen.effect: The character makes an Ego check against an enemy in their line of sight and compares that against the target's Vigilance defense. If the attack is a success, the enemy is deafened for one turn. On a Fantastic success, it also inflicts regular damage.
Deafen.short_effect:
Ego vs. Vigilance (line of sight, 20 spaces)
• Success: Deafen target for 1 turn
• Fantastic: Deafen for 1 turn and deal damage

Defense Stance.name: Defense Stance
Defense Stance.description: The character enters a fluid defensive stance, hands poised to parry and counterattack.
Defense Stance.effect: Any close attacks made against the character have trouble until they are successfully attacked in this combat.
Defense Stance.short_effect: Close attacks vs. you have trouble until you're successfully hit

Dimensional Portal.name: Dimensional Portal
Dimensional Portal.description: The character opens a portal to another place.
Dimensional Portal.effect: The character opens a glowing portal in a space next to them that moves anything that enters it between that space and its destination, which forms a matched glowing portal in the other place. The other end of the portal must be in a clear space in another dimension that the character has been to. Anything can move through the portal in either direction until it is closed, which the character can do at will.
Dimensional Portal.short_effect:
Open two-way portal to another dimension (must have visited)
Anything can travel through in either direction; close at will

Dimensional Travel.name: Dimensional Travel
Dimensional Travel.description: The character moves from one dimension to another.
Dimensional Travel.effect: The character instantly moves from their current dimension to another dimension within the same universe. For instance: from Earth to Asgard, Limbo or K'un-Lun. When they move to the other dimension, they can arrive in any place they've been to before. Otherwise, they arrive at the most common entrance to that dimension.
Dimensional Travel.short_effect:
Instantly travel to another dimension (same universe)
Arrive at place you've visited, or closest corresponding space

Dimensional Travel Other.name: Dimensional Travel Other
Dimensional Travel Other.description: The character sends someone to another dimension.
Dimensional Travel Other.effect: The character makes an Ego check against the Vigilance defense of a target they have grabbed. If the check is successful, the character can send the target to another dimension. The target can be sent to any location in that dimension that the character has been to before. Otherwise, the target arrives at the most common entrance to that dimension.
Dimensional Travel Other.short_effect:
Ego vs. Vigilance (grabbed target)
• Success: Send target to another dimension (place you've visited or closest corresponding space)

Dimensional Travel Together.name: Dimensional Travel Together
Dimensional Travel Together.description: The character brings someone with them to another dimension.
Dimensional Travel Together.effect: The character moves to a different dimension, taking any person they are touching with them. If the target does not wish to come along, the character must grab them first. When they move to the other dimension, they can arrive in any place they've been to before. Otherwise, they arrive at the most common entrance to that dimension.
Dimensional Travel Together.short_effect:
Travel to another dimension with person you're touching (must grab unwilling target)
Arrive at place you've visited, or closest corresponding space

Discipline 1.name: Discipline 1
Discipline 1.description: The character works to hone their power.
Discipline 1.effect: The character adds +1 to their Ego damage multiplier, and they gain a +1 bonus to Ego checks other than attacks.
Discipline 1.short_effect: +1 Ego damage multiplier; +1 to non-attack Ego checks

Discipline 2.name: Discipline 2
Discipline 2.description: The character is more in touch with their power than ever.
Discipline 2.effect: The character adds +2 to their Ego damage multiplier, and they gain a +2 bonus to Ego checks other than attacks.
Discipline 2.short_effect: +2 Ego damage multiplier; +2 to non-attack Ego checks

Discipline 3.name: Discipline 3
Discipline 3.description: Few can top the character's grasp on their power.
Discipline 3.effect: The character adds +3 to their Ego damage multiplier, and they gain a +3 bonus to Ego checks other than attacks.
Discipline 3.short_effect: +3 Ego damage multiplier; +3 to non-attack Ego checks

Discipline 4.name: Discipline 4
Discipline 4.description: The character has mastered their power.
Discipline 4.effect: The character adds +4 to their Ego damage multiplier, and they gain a +4 bonus to Ego checks other than attacks.
Discipline 4.short_effect: +4 Ego damage multiplier; +4 to non-attack Ego checks

Disguise.name: Disguise
Disguise.description: The character appears to be someone else.
Disguise.effect: The character instantly alters their appearance so that they appear to be someone else. The target number for anyone trying to see through the disguise is the character's Ego defense. If the character is impersonating someone known to the other person, that person has an edge.
Disguise.short_effect:
Instantly alter appearance
See through TN = your Ego defense (edge if impersonating someone known to them)

Dispel Spell.name: Dispel Spell
Dispel Spell.description: The character puts an end to a foe's magic.
Dispel Spell.effect: The character makes an Ego check against the Ego defense of a target using a magic power that requires concentration. On a success, the target's concentration on that power is broken. On a Fantastic success, the target's concentration is broken entirely.
Dispel Spell.short_effect:
Ego vs. Ego defense (target using magic concentration power)
• Success: Break concentration
• Fantastic: Break all concentrations

Disrupt Electronics.name: Disrupt Electronics
Disrupt Electronics.description: The character can scramble electronics by moving through them.
Disrupt Electronics.effect: When phasing through electronics, the character can scramble them, causing them to either shut down or crash. In the case of powers that are Tech Reliant (and feature electronics), they are unusable for one turn while they reboot.
Disrupt Electronics.short_effect:
When phasing through electronics: Scramble them (shut down/crash)
Tech Reliant powers unusable 1 turn (reboot)

Disrupt Nerves.name: Disrupt Nerves
Disrupt Nerves.description: The character can scramble someone's nervous system.
Disrupt Nerves.effect: When phasing through a person, the character can attempt to scramble their nervous system. The character makes an Ego check against the target's Resilience defense. On a success, the target is stunned for one round. On a Fantastic success, the target also falls prone.
Disrupt Nerves.short_effect:
Ego vs. Resilience (when phasing through target)
• Success: Stun for 1 round
• Fantastic: Stun and prone

Disrupt Person.name: Disrupt Person
Disrupt Person.description: The character can hurt someone with their phasing powers.
Disrupt Person.effect: The character becomes the slightest bit solid while phasing themselves or a phased weapon through someone. They make a close attack. On a success, the attack does normal damage, ignoring any Health Damage Reduction. On a Fantastic success, the attack does double damage instead, ignoring any Health Damage Reduction, and the target is stunned for one round.
Disrupt Person.short_effect:
Close attack while phasing (ignore Health Damage Reduction)
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage, stun for 1 round

Do This All Day.name: Do This All Day
Do This All Day.description: The character draws on their inner strength to heal themselves.
Do This All Day.effect: The character heals 2 points of Health for every point of Focus they spend.

Domination.name: Domination
Domination.description: The character forces someone to follow their orders-permanently.
Domination.effect: The character dominates a target with whom they've established a Telepathic Link and who has no Focus left. The character makes a Logic check with trouble against the target's Logic defense. On a success, the target is completely dominated and will follow the character's orders. On a Fantastic success, the character gains an edge the next time they use this power against this same target. The result of the character's check is the target number for any attempts by the target to end the domination. If any order involves harming someone, the target gets to make a Logic check to end the domination. If the target has the Heroic tag, they get an edge on the check. If the order would cause the target to harm themselves, the target gets an edge on the check. If they have the Heroic tag, they get a double edge.
Domination.short_effect:
Logic with trouble vs. Logic (telepathic link target with 0 Focus)
• Success: Completely dominated (your check = TN to end)
• Fantastic: Edge next time
Orders to harm: Target checks to end (Heroic: edge; harm self: double edge)

Double Tap.name: Double Tap
Double Tap.effect: The character makes a ranged attack against an enemy within 2 spaces. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage and is bleeding.
Double Tap.short_effect:
Ranged attack (within 2 spaces)
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and bleeding

Edit Memory.name: Edit Memory
Edit Memory.effect: The character alters the memory of a target with whom they've established a Telepathic Link. This can be as simple as erasing a chunk of the target's memory or as complicated as implanting entirely new memories. The Narrator sets the target number based on how complex the new memory is and how hard it would be to integrate such memories into the character's other memories. The character makes a Logic check against the target's Logic defense. On a success, the memories are altered. On a Fantastic success, the target has trouble on checks to refute such memories in the future. Any time the target is given good reason to doubt the edited memory, they can make a Logic check to refute the new version of their memories and recover their original memories. If they succeed, they remember both the original memory and the edited one. On a Fantastic success, they know for sure who did this to them.
Edit Memory.short_effect:
Logic vs. Logic (telepathic link target)
• Success: Erase/implant memories (Narrator sets TN by complexity)
• Fantastic: Trouble to refute
Target can Logic check to recover if given reason to doubt

Elemental Barrage.name: Elemental Barrage
Elemental Barrage.description: The character hurls a barrage of their element at their foes.
Elemental Barrage.effect: The character designates a space within their line of sight. The attack can affect every enemy within 10 spaces of that. The character makes a single Ego check and compares it to each target's Resilience defense. Affected enemies take half regular damage. On a Fantastic success, they take full regular damage and the elemental type's special effect.
Elemental Barrage.short_effect:
Ego vs. Resilience for all enemies within 10 spaces of target point (line of sight)
• Success: Each takes ½ damage
• Fantastic: Each takes full damage and special effect

Elemental Barrier.name: Elemental Barrier
Elemental Barrier.description: The character forms a wall of their element.
Elemental Barrier.effect: The character forms a wall of their element within their line of sight and up to 10 spaces away per rank. This covers up to 2 spaces across (vertically/horizontally) per their rank. The character makes an Agility check and compares the results against the Agility defense of any target in the affected spaces. On a success, the character chooses which side of the barrier the target winds up on. On a failure, the target chooses. On a Fantastic success, the target suffers the element's special effect too. Attacks against the barrier are against the character's Ego defense. Any attacks against it that do 10 points of damage or less are instantly absorbed, and the barrier continues. If an attack does more than 10 points of damage, it destroys the barrier. Either way, the attack leaves those behind the barrier unharmed.
Elemental Barrier.short_effect:
Wall (2 spaces per rank, within 10 spaces/rank, line of sight)
• Agility vs. Agility defense: Choose which side target ends up (Fantastic: also special effect)
• Absorbs ≤10 damage attacks; destroyed if >10 damage

Elemental Blast.name: Elemental Blast
Elemental Blast.description: The character blasts a foe with their element.
Elemental Blast.effect: The character makes a ranged attack with an edge at an enemy in line of sight. For this attack, add +1 to the character's Agility damage bonus for every 2 points of Focus they spend. On a success, an affected target takes that total damage. On a Fantastic success, an affected target takes double that total damage and suffers the elemental type's special effect.
Elemental Blast.short_effect:
Ranged attack with edge (line of sight, 10 spaces)
+1 Agility damage per 2 Focus spent
• Success: Total damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and special effect

Elemental Burst.name: Elemental Burst
Elemental Burst.description: The character fires a burst of their element.
Elemental Burst.effect: The character makes a ranged attack against an enemy in line of sight. If the attack is a success, it inflicts regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage instead and the elemental type's special effect.
Elemental Burst.short_effect:
Ranged attack (line of sight, 10 spaces)
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and special effect

Elemental Form.name: Elemental Form
Elemental Form.description: The character's body is made of their element.
Elemental Form.effect: The character's body is made entirely of their element, which gives them a steady supply of their element to use and makes them essentially unkillable. When they lose all their Health, their form loses its cohesion and falls apart. When they have at least 1 Health-which they can gain back over time, normally-they can re-form. If the character wishes to use their elemental body in unusual ways, they should pick Plasticity powers. If they wish to be able to be fully human at times, they should take the Shape-Shift power.
Elemental Form.short_effect:
Body made of element; steady supply; unkillable
At 0 Health: Form falls apart; re-form when ≥1 Health
Use Plasticity for unusual body uses; Shape-Shift to be human

Elemental Grab.name: Elemental Grab
Elemental Grab.description: The character uses their element to snare a target.
Elemental Grab.effect: The character makes an Ego attack against a target's Melee defense within 5 spaces times the character's rank.
