If the attack is a success, the character grabs the target with their element. On a Fantastic success, the target can also be pinned and suffers the element's special effect. Breaking free requires a successful Melee check against target number 20.
Elemental Grab.short_effect:
Ego vs. Melee (5 spaces × rank)
• Success: Grab target
• Fantastic: Grab, pin, and special effect
• Escape: Melee check TN 20

Elemental Infusion.name: Elemental Infusion
Elemental Infusion.description: The character infuses a weapon with their element.
Elemental Infusion.effect: The character infuses their energy into a handheld weapon in their grasp. When the character gets a Fantastic success attacking with the weapon, add the energy's special effect.
Elemental Infusion.short_effect:
Infuse handheld weapon with element
Fantastic success attacks add element's special effect

Elemental Prison.name: Elemental Prison
Elemental Prison.description: The character can create a cage of their element.
Elemental Prison.effect: The character picks a point within their line of sight and traps any chosen targets within up to 5 spaces times their rank-in a prison comprised of their element. When the Elemental Prison is formed, the character makes an Ego check and compares the results against the Agility defense of targets inside the enclosed spaces. On each success, the character traps the target within the prison's perimeter. On a Fantastic success, such imprisoned people suffer full damage and the element's special effect too. Attacks against the prison are against the character's Ego defense. Any attacks against the prison are absorbed as if made against the character's Elemental Protection power, and the prison continues. If an attack does more damage than the character's Elemental Protection power can sustain, it destroys the prison, but no one inside is harmed.
Elemental Prison.short_effect:
Trap chosen targets (5 spaces × rank, line of sight)
• Ego vs. Agility defense: Trap target (Fantastic: also full damage and special effect)
• Prison absorbs damage per Elemental Protection level; destroyed if exceeded

Elemental Protection 1.name: Elemental Protection 1
Elemental Protection 1.description: The character protects themselves with their element.
Elemental Protection 1.trigger: The character is attacked or otherwise in danger.
Elemental Protection 1.effect: The character protects themselves with their element. Any attacks against them that do 10 points of damage or less are instantly absorbed, and the protection continues. If an attack does more than 10 points of damage, it destroys the protection. Either way, the character remains unharmed.
Elemental Protection 1.short_effect: Absorb attacks ≤10 damage; destroyed if >10 damage; you remain unharmed either way

Elemental Protection 2.name: Elemental Protection 2
Elemental Protection 2.description: The character's elemental protection is like armor.
Elemental Protection 2.trigger: The character is attacked or otherwise in danger.
Elemental Protection 2.effect: The character protects themselves with their element. Any attacks against them that do 20 points of damage or less are instantly absorbed, and the protection continues. If an attack does more than 20 points of damage, it destroys the protection. Either way, the character remains unharmed.
Elemental Protection 2.short_effect: Absorb attacks ≤20 damage; destroyed if >20 damage; you remain unharmed either way

Elemental Protection 3.name: Elemental Protection 3
Elemental Protection 3.description: The character's elemental protection is like a tank.
Elemental Protection 3.trigger: The character is attacked or otherwise in danger.
Elemental Protection 3.effect: The character protects themselves with their element. Any attacks against them that do 30 points of damage or less are instantly absorbed, and the protection continues. If an attack does more than 30 points of damage, it destroys the protection. Either way, the character remains unharmed.
Elemental Protection 3.short_effect: Absorb attacks ≤30 damage; destroyed if >30 damage; you remain unharmed either way

Elemental Protection 4.name: Elemental Protection 4
Elemental Protection 4.description: The character's elemental protection is like a fortress.
Elemental Protection 4.trigger: The character is attacked or otherwise in danger.
Elemental Protection 4.effect: The character protects themselves with their element. Any attacks against them that do 40 points of damage or less are instantly absorbed, and the protection continues. If an attack does more than 40 points of damage, it destroys the protection. Either way, the character remains unharmed.
Elemental Protection 4.short_effect: Absorb attacks ≤40 damage; destroyed if >40 damage; you remain unharmed either way

Elemental Push.name: Elemental Push
Elemental Push.description: The character can move a target with their element.
Elemental Push.effect: The character makes an Ego attack against the target's Agility defense. If the attack succeeds, the character can move the target in any direction, up to 1 space times the character's rank. On a Fantastic success, the target also takes regular damage, is knocked prone and suffers the element's special effect.
Elemental Push.short_effect:
Ego vs. Agility
• Success: Move target up to 1 space × rank
• Fantastic: Move, deal damage, knock prone, and special effect

Elemental Reinforcement.name: Elemental Reinforcement
Elemental Reinforcement.description: The character reinforces their powers with their element.
Elemental Reinforcement.trigger: Damage gets through an elemental power
Elemental Reinforcement.effect: The character can transfer any Health damage that gets through an elemental power that grants damage protection to their Focus instead, leaving the protection intact.
Elemental Reinforcement.short_effect: Reaction: Transfer Health damage from elemental protection to Focus instead (keeps protection intact)

Elemental Ricochet.name: Elemental Ricochet
Elemental Ricochet.description: The character bounces the burst off one foe and into another.
Elemental Ricochet.effect: The character makes a ranged attack against a target in line of sight. If the attack is a success, it inflicts regular damage. On a Fantastic success, energy also bounces off the first target to another in line of sight, and the character can make a new attack against that target, adding the new range to the previous attack's range. This can be repeated until an attack is not fantastic.
Elemental Ricochet.short_effect:
Ranged attack (line of sight, 10 spaces × rank)
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: Regular damage, then chain to next visible target (repeat until non-Fantastic)

Elemental Sphere.name: Elemental Sphere
Elemental Sphere.description: The character can create a protective sphere of their element.
Elemental Sphere.effect: The character envelops themselves-and any chosen people within up to 5 spaces times their rank-in a protective sphere comprised of their element. When the sphere is formed, the character makes an Ego check and compares the results against the Agility defense of unwanted characters in the enclosed spaces. On a success, such moved people suffer full damage and the element's special effect. Attacks against the sphere are against the character's Ego defense. Any attacks against the sphere are absorbed as if made against the character's Elemental Protection power, and the sphere continues. If an attack does more damage than the character's Elemental Protection power can sustain, it destroys the sphere, but no one inside is harmed.
Elemental Sphere.short_effect:
Protective sphere around you and chosen allies (5 spaces × rank)
• Ego vs. Agility defense: Unwanted targets take full damage and special effect
• Absorbs damage per Elemental Protection level; destroyed if exceeded

Elemental Suffocation.name: Elemental Suffocation
Elemental Suffocation.description: The character envelops a target's head in an element.
Elemental Suffocation.trigger: The target is grabbed with Elemental Grab.
Elemental Suffocation.effect: The character makes an Ego attack against the grabbed target's Resilience defense. If the attack is a success, the target takes regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the target can also be pinned and suffers the element's special effect. With elements that aren't suited to suffocation, this power chokes the target instead.
Elemental Suffocation.short_effect:
Ego vs. Resilience (reaction vs. grabbed target)
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: Regular damage, pin, and special effect

Energy Absorption.name: Energy Absorption
Energy Absorption.description: The character turns damage into power.
Energy Absorption.effect: The character can take any Health damage done to them (after applying any damage reduction), ignore it and add that number to their Focus instead. In this way, they can increase their Focus up to double their regular maximum Focus. Once the combat is over, any extra Focus over the character's regular maximum Focus score fades away.
Energy Absorption.short_effect:
Reaction: Convert Health damage (after reduction) to Focus instead
Can exceed max Focus up to 2× normal; excess fades after combat

Environmental Protection.name: Environmental Protection
Environmental Protection.description: Environmental effects don't bother the character.
Environmental Protection.effect: The character is not harmed by intense cold or heat, the pressure of the deep seas or the intense radiation and vacuum of space. The player can choose any or all of these protections, as best fits with the character concept.
Environmental Protection.short_effect:
Not harmed by intense cold/heat, deep sea pressure, or space radiation/vacuum
(Choose any/all protections)

ESP.name: ESP
ESP.description: The character can sense the presence of others.
ESP.effect: The character can reach out with their mind to sense the presence of others within 100 spaces per rank. This tells them the person's location and general status. It can also identify if they have super-powers or not. If a target or targets wish to remain undetected, the character must make a Logic check and compare it against each target's Vigilance defense. If they succeed, they sense the target. On a Fantastic success, they can also identify the source of any powers the target has.
ESP.short_effect:
Sense others' presence (100 spaces/rank): location, status, if they have powers
Unwilling targets: Logic vs. Vigilance (Fantastic: identify power source)

Evasion.name: Evasion
Evasion.description: The character can dodge fists quickly.
Evasion.effect: The character can use their Agility defense score against Melee attacks too.
Evasion.short_effect: Use Agility defense vs. Melee attacks

Exorcism.name: Exorcism
Exorcism.description: The character removes an intruder from someone's body.
Exorcism.effect: The character attempts to remove the possessor from a possessed target. The character makes an Ego check against the possessor's Ego defense. On a success, the possessor's concentration is broken, ending the possession. On a Fantastic success, all of the possessor's concentrations are broken, and the possessor is stunned for one round too.
Exorcism.short_effect:
Ego vs. possessor's Ego
• Success: Break concentration, end possession
• Fantastic: Break all concentrations, stun possessor for 1 round

Exploit.name: Exploit
Exploit.description: The character finds a weak spot and exploits it.
Exploit.trigger: A Fantastic success on an attack using the character's weapon that deals at least 1 point of damage
Exploit.effect: The character makes a Melee attack against the target's Resilience defense score. If the attack is a success, the damage it does ignores Health Damage Reduction. On a Fantastic success, the target suffers double damage and the weapon's special effect.
Exploit.short_effect:
Melee vs. Resilience (reaction after weapon Fantastic success)
• Success: Damage ignores Health Damage Reduction
• Fantastic: 2× damage, ignore reduction, and weapon special effect

Extend Invisibility.name: Extend Invisibility
Extend Invisibility.description: The character makes something else invisible.
Extend Invisibility.effect: The character makes something-a single person or object-within reach invisible. This can be one size bigger than them for every rank they have.
Extend Invisibility.short_effect: Make person/object within reach invisible (+1 size/rank)

Extended Reach 2.name: Extended Reach 2
Extended Reach 2.description: The character can reach a looong way.
Extended Reach 2.effect: The character's reach is 10 times normal.

Fast Attacks.name: Fast Attacks
Fast Attacks.effect: The character splits their attack to make two close attacks against separate targets within reach (or they can focus a single attack on a single target). Make a single Melee check and compare it to the targets' Melee defenses. On a success, the affected target takes half regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the affected target takes full damage, and the character can make a bonus attack with this power against any target within reach, with the same effect.
Fast Attacks.short_effect:
Single Melee check vs. two targets within reach (or one target)
• Success: Each takes ½ damage
• Fantastic: Each takes full damage, plus bonus attack vs. any target in reach

Fast Hands.name: Fast Hands
Fast Hands.description: The character can shoot faster than the eye can blink.
Fast Hands.effect: The character gains one additional reaction per round. This reaction can be used only to trigger a Ranged Weapons power.
Fast Hands.short_effect: +1 reaction per round (can only use for Ranged Weapons powers)

Fast Strikes.name: Fast Strikes
Fast Strikes.description: The character unleashes a flurry of strikes.
Fast Strikes.effect: The character splits their attack to make two close attacks against separate targets within reach (or they can focus a single attack on a single target). Make a single Melee check and compare it to the targets' Melee defenses. On a success, the affected target takes half regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the affected target takes full damage.
Fast Strikes.short_effect:
Single Melee check vs. two targets within reach (or one target)
• Success: Each takes ½ damage
• Fantastic: Each takes full damage

Flames of the Faltine.name: Flames of the Faltine
Flames of the Faltine.description: The character shoots jets of enchanted fire from their hands.
Flames of the Faltine.effect: The character makes an Ego check against the Agility defense of a target in their line of sight. If the attack is a success, it inflicts regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the target takes double damage and then suffers 5 points of damage at the end of every round until someone uses an action to put out the flames.
Flames of the Faltine.short_effect:
Ego vs. Agility (line of sight, 10 spaces)
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and 5 damage/round until flames extinguished (requires action)

Flare.name: Flare
Flare.description: The character generates a dazzling flare of light.
Flare.effect: The character makes an Ego check and compares that against the Vigilance defense of every enemy within 5 spaces. Each beaten enemy is blinded for one turn. On a Fantastic success, the flare inflicts regular damage too.
Flare.short_effect:
Ego vs. Vigilance for all enemies within 5 spaces
• Success: Blind for 1 turn
• Fantastic: Blind for 1 turn and deal damage

Flexible Bones 1.name: Flexible Bones 1
Flexible Bones 1.effect: The character gains Health Damage Reduction 1. They also have an edge on Agility checks for contortion and escape.
Flexible Bones 1.short_effect: Health Damage Reduction 1; edge on Agility checks for contortion/escape

Flexible Bones 2.name: Flexible Bones 2
Flexible Bones 2.description: The character's skeleton is flexible and pliable.
Flexible Bones 2.effect: The character gains Health Damage Reduction 2. They also have a double edge on Agility checks for contortion and escape.
Flexible Bones 2.short_effect: Health Damage Reduction 2; double edge on Agility checks for contortion/escape

Flexible Fingers.name: Flexible Fingers
Flexible Fingers.description: The character can turn their fingers and hands into whatever tool they need.
Flexible Fingers.effect: With a standard action, the character can automatically pick any lock that requires a physical key. They can also shape their hands to form almost any other kind of simple tool.
Flexible Fingers.short_effect:
Auto-pick locks requiring physical key
Shape hands into simple tools

Flight 1.name: Flight 1
Flight 1.description: The character can soar into the sky.
Flight 1.effect: The character can fly. Their combat Flight Speed is equal to their rank times their Run Speed. Outside of combat, they can move three times their Flight Speed.
Flight 1.short_effect:
Gain Flight movement mode
Combat: Flight Speed = rank × Run Speed
Outside combat: 3× Flight Speed

Flight 2.name: Flight 2
Flight 2.description: The character can zoom across the sky.
Flight 2.effect: Outside of combat, the character can fly up to 50 times their Flight Speed.
Flight 2.short_effect: Outside combat: Fly up to 50× Flight Speed

Flying Double Kick.name: Flying Double Kick
Flying Double Kick.description: The character leaps into the air and snap kicks two enemies at once.
Flying Double Kick.effect: The character makes a close attack against two enemies within reach. If an attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage. If an attack is a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage and is knocked prone.
Flying Double Kick.short_effect:
Close attack vs. two enemies within reach
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and knocked prone

Focus Fire.name: Focus Fire
Focus Fire.description: The character calls out a target.
Focus Fire.effect: The character calls out an enemy in line of sight and inspires one or more allies of their choice in earshot, up to the character's Vigilance. They gain an edge on all action checks against that enemy.
Focus Fire.short_effect: Allies in earshot (up to Vigilance) gain edge on all checks vs. called enemy (line of sight)

Focused Fury.name: Focused Fury
Focused Fury.description: The character channels their rage into a devastating blow.
Focused Fury.effect: The character makes a close attack with an edge. For this attack, add +1 to the character's Melee damage bonus for every 2 points of Focus they spend. On a success, an affected target takes that total damage. On a Fantastic success, an affected target takes double that total damage and suffers the weapon's special effect.
Focused Fury.short_effect:
Close attack with edge
+1 Melee damage per 2 Focus spent
• Success: Total damage
• Fantastic: 2× total damage and weapon special effect

Focused Strike.name: Focused Strike
Focused Strike.description: The character finds the right spot and strikes.
Focused Strike.effect: The character makes a close attack. Add +1 to the character's Melee damage bonus for every 2 points of Focus they spend. On a success, an affected target takes that total damage. On a Fantastic success, an affected target takes double that total damage and is stunned for one round.
Focused Strike.short_effect:
Close attack
+1 Melee damage per 2 Focus spent
• Success: Total damage
• Fantastic: 2× total damage and stunned for 1 round

Fool.name: Fool
Fool.description: The character makes people believe they are someone else.
Fool.effect: The character uses a mirage to alter their appearance in the minds of anyone within 20 spaces per rank. Cameras (for instance) can still record them normally, but when people look in the character's direction, they see someone else. The target number for anyone trying to see through the mirage is the character's Logic defense. If the character is impersonating someone known to the other person, that person has an edge.
Fool.short_effect:
Alter your appearance in minds (20 spaces/rank)
Cameras record normally
See through TN = your Logic defense (edge if impersonating known person)

Furious Attacks.name: Furious Attacks
Furious Attacks.description: The character's weapons smash into the foe.
Furious Attacks.effect: The character splits their attack to make two close attacks against separate targets within reach (or they can focus a single attack on a single target). Make a single Melee check and compare it to the targets' Melee defenses. For these attacks, add +1 to the character's Melee damage bonus for every 2 points of Focus they spend. On a success, an affected target takes half that total damage. On a Fantastic success, an affected target takes full damage and suffers the weapon's special effect.
Furious Attacks.short_effect:
Single Melee check vs. two targets within reach (or one target)
+1 Melee damage per 2 Focus spent
• Success: Each takes ½ total damage
• Fantastic: Each takes full total damage and weapon special effect

Grand Fool.name: Grand Fool
Grand Fool.description: The character mentally makes the group they're with appear to be like other people.
Grand Fool.effect: The character uses a mirage to alter their appearance-and the appearance of up to one other person per rank, within 10 spaces-in the minds of people within 20 spaces per rank. Cameras (for instance) can still record them, but when people look in the characters' direction, they see other people. The target number for anyone trying to see through the mirage is the character's Logic defense. If the affected characters are impersonating people known to the other person, that person has an edge.
Grand Fool.short_effect:
Alter appearance of you + targets (1 per rank, within 10 spaces) in minds (20 spaces/rank)
Cameras record normally
See through TN = your Logic defense (edge if impersonating known person)

Grand Illusion.name: Grand Illusion
Grand Illusion.description: By manipulating light and sound, the character creates an incredibly real hologram.
Grand Illusion.effect: The character creates a sound and sight illusion anywhere in line of sight, within 50 spaces. The illusion can be of anything up to five sizes larger than the character, and it can move freely within its limits. The character breaks concentration if they move beyond 50 spaces from the illusion or lose line of sight of it.
Grand Illusion.short_effect:
Sound & sight illusion (line of sight, 50 spaces, +5 sizes)
Movement: Run Speed
See through: Vigilance vs. Ego
Damage/concentration breaks it

Grand Mirage.name: Grand Mirage
Grand Mirage.description: The character can make a mirage appear in a group's mind.
Grand Mirage.effect: The character creates a full-sensory mirage that affects everyone in a Telepathic Network they set up who is also in the same locale. The mirage can be of anything the character desires, and it can move freely.
Grand Mirage.short_effect:
Full-sensory mirage for everyone in Telepathic Network (same locale)
Moves freely

Grappling Technique.name: Grappling Technique
Grappling Technique.effect: The character makes a close attack. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage and is grabbed. On a Fantastic success, the target takes double damage instead and is pinned too.
Grappling Technique.short_effect:
Close attack
• Success: Regular damage and grab
• Fantastic: 2× damage and pin

Ground-Shaking Stomp.name: Ground-Shaking Stomp
Ground-Shaking Stomp.description: The character smashes the ground so hard the earth trembles.
Ground-Shaking Stomp.effect: The character makes a Melee check and compares that against the Agility defense of every target within the character's reach plus their rank in spaces. Any targets the attack succeeds against take half regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the targets take full damage and are knocked prone.
Ground-Shaking Stomp.short_effect:
Melee vs. Agility for all within reach + rank spaces
• Success: Each takes ½ damage
• Fantastic: Each takes full damage and knocked prone

Group Flight.name: Group Flight
Group Flight.description: The character can carry others with them into the sky.
Group Flight.effect: For every point of Ego the character has, they can hoist one ally into the air with them. The Flight Speed of the group is half the character's, and all affected allies must remain within 5 spaces times the character's rank. The character controls each ally's speed and position during the character's turn, but they can release any or all allies at any time.
Group Flight.short_effect:
Hoist allies (1 per Ego point) into air
Group Flight Speed = ½ your Flight Speed; all within 5 spaces of you

Group Invisibility.name: Group Invisibility
Group Invisibility.description: The character can make something else invisible.
Group Invisibility.effect: For every point of Ego defense the character has, they can make one person or thing invisible, including themselves. Each of these can be one size bigger than them for every rank they have.
Group Invisibility.short_effect:
Make people/things invisible (1 per Ego defense point)
Each can be +1 size per rank bigger than you

Group Levitation.name: Group Levitation
Group Levitation.description: The character can lift others into the air too.
Group Levitation.effect: The character can move up to one person per rank through the air in any direction at the character's Run Speed. The levitated target(s) must remain within 5 spaces times the character's rank. If any target does not wish to be moved like this, they must be telekinetically grabbed first.
Group Levitation.short_effect:
Move targets (1 per rank) through air at your Run Speed
Targets within 10 spaces × rank

Grow 1.name: Grow 1
Grow 1.effect: The character can grow up to huge size. They can return to their normal size at will.
Grow 1.short_effect:
Grow to Huge size
Return to normal at will

Grow 2.name: Grow 2
Grow 2.effect: The character can grow up to gigantic size. They can return to their normal size at will.
Grow 2.short_effect:
Grow to Gigantic size
Return to normal at will

Grow 3.name: Grow 3
Grow 3.description: The character can be the size of a house!
Grow 3.effect: The character can grow up to titanic size. They can return to their normal size at will.
Grow 3.short_effect:
Grow to Titanic size
Return to normal at will

Grow 4.name: Grow 4
Grow 4.effect: The character can grow up to gargantuan size. They can return to their normal size at will.
Grow 4.short_effect:
Grow to Gargantuan size
Return to normal at will

Growing Attack.name: Growing Attack
Growing Attack.description: The character attacks as they grow
Growing Attack.effect: The character makes a close attack with an edge. If the attack succeeds, they do regular damage for the size they are growing to. On a Fantastic success, they do double damage and stun the target.
Growing Attack.short_effect:
Close attack with edge (reaction while growing)
• Success: Damage for new size
• Fantastic: 2× damage for new size and stun

Headshot.name: Headshot
Headshot.effect: The character makes a ranged attack with trouble on an enemy within the weapon's range. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes double normal damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes triple damage. Either way, if the enemy suffers any actual damage, they are also stunned for one round.
Headshot.short_effect:
Ranged attack with trouble (within weapon range)
• Success: 2× damage and stunned if any damage dealt
• Fantastic: 3× damage and stunned if any damage dealt

Healing Factor.name: Healing Factor
Healing Factor.effect: At the end of the character's turn, they regain Health equal to their Resilience. (This works outside of combat too, quickly bringing them back to full Health.)
Healing Factor.short_effect:
Regain Health = Resilience at end of your turn
(Works outside combat too)

Heightened Senses 1.name: Heightened Senses 1
Heightened Senses 1.effect: The character can sense things roughly twice as far away as normal. They also have an edge on Vigilance checks to perceive things, and enemies have trouble on checks they make to sneak past the character.
Heightened Senses 1.short_effect: Sense 2× distance; edge on Vigilance to perceive; enemies have trouble on Vigilance vs. you

Heightened Senses 2.name: Heightened Senses 2
Heightened Senses 2.description: The character has senses as sharp as radar.
Heightened Senses 2.effect: The character can sense things roughly four times as far away as normal. Their senses are so sharp that they can use some of them to compensate for the loss of others (say, if blinded or deafened). They can even listen to the heartbeat of a person in the same room to see if they are lying-although this is as reliable as a traditional lie detector: far from 100% and not admissible in court. They also have a double edge on Vigilance checks to perceive things, and enemies have double trouble on checks they make to sneak past the character.
Heightened Senses 2.short_effect: Sense 4× distance; can compensate for lost senses; triple edge on Vigilance to perceive; enemies have double trouble on Vigilance vs. you

Hellfire Chains.name: Hellfire Chains
Hellfire Chains.description: The character shoots out chains covered in hellfire.
Hellfire Chains.effect: The character summons chains covered in hellfire and can use them to bind or smash targets. They can attack anyone within 10 spaces per rank and line of sight. Make an Ego attack. On a success, the target takes regular Health damage. On a Fantastic success, the target is grabbed and paralyzed too. If a target is grabbed by the hellfire chains, on each subsequent round, the character can make an Ego check against the target's Resilience Resilience defense to inflict regular Health damage and regular Focus damage. Breaking free from the hellfire chains requires a Melee check with a target number of 20.
Hellfire Chains.short_effect:
Ego attack (line of sight, 10 spaces × rank)
• Success: Regular Health damage
• Fantastic: Regular Health damage, grab, and paralyze
• Each round while grabbed: Ego vs. Resilience for Health + Focus damage
• Escape: Melee check TN 20

Hex Bolt.name: Hex Bolt
Hex Bolt.description: The character hurls a hex bolt at their foe.
Hex Bolt.effect: The character fires a hex bolt at a foe. Make an Ego check against the target's Agility defense. On a success, the attack does regular damage. On a Fantastic success, it does double damage and causes the target trouble for one round.
Hex Bolt.short_effect:
Ego vs. Agility
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and trouble for 1 round

Hit & Run.name: Hit & Run
Hit & Run.description: The character hits hard and keeps moving!
Hit & Run.effect: The character makes a close attack with an edge on an enemy. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage, and the character can make an additional movement up to half their Run Speed for free. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage and suffers the weapon's special effect.
Hit & Run.short_effect:
Close attack with edge
• Success: Regular damage and move up to ½ Run Speed for free
• Fantastic: 2× damage, weapon special effect, and move ½ Run Speed

Hit the Dirt.name: Hit the Dirt
Hit the Dirt.description: The character gets their allies to take cover.
Hit the Dirt.trigger: An enemy in line of sight makes an attack on an ally within earshot.
Hit the Dirt.effect: All allies within earshot can fall prone if they wish and are able to. If falling prone makes the ally an ineligible target for the initial attack, the attack automatically fails.
Hit the Dirt.short_effect:
Reaction: All allies within earshot can fall prone
If prone makes them ineligible target, attack auto-fails

Hurled Shield Bash.name: Hurled Shield Bash
Hurled Shield Bash.description: The character hurls their mighty shield at an enemy.
Hurled Shield Bash.effect: The character makes a ranged attack on an enemy. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage and is knocked prone. The shield then bounces back to the character.
Hurled Shield Bash.short_effect:
Ranged attack (10 spaces × rank)
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and knocked prone
Shield returns to you

Hurled Shield Block.name: Hurled Shield Block
Hurled Shield Block.description: The character hurls their mighty shield to protect an ally from an attack.
Hurled Shield Block.trigger: An enemy makes an attack against an ally's Agility.
Hurled Shield Block.effect: The ally gains Health Damage Reduction equal to the character's Shield power against that attack. The shield then bounces back to the character.
Hurled Shield Block.short_effect:
Reaction to protect ally (5 spaces × rank)
Ally gains Health Damage Reduction = your Shield power level
Shield returns to you

Hurled Shield Deflection.name: Hurled Shield Deflection
Hurled Shield Deflection.description: The character hurls their mighty shield to save an ally from an attack.
Hurled Shield Deflection.trigger: An enemy makes an attack against an ally's Agility.
Hurled Shield Deflection.effect: The enemy has trouble on the attack. The shield then bounces back to the character.
Hurled Shield Deflection.short_effect:
Reaction vs. attack on target (5 spaces × rank)
Enemy has trouble on attack
Shield returns to you

Iconic Weapon.name: Iconic Weapon
Iconic Weapon.effect: The character is known for owning and using a unique and powerful weapon, like Mjolnir (Thor's hammer) or Captain America's shield. The Narrator must approve the details of this weapon. This power can be taken more than once, but each time must be with a different weapon.
Iconic Weapon.short_effect:
Own unique powerful weapon (Narrator approval required)
Can take multiple times for different weapons

Icy Tendrils of Ikthalon.name: Icy Tendrils of Ikthalon
Icy Tendrils of Ikthalon.description: The character unleashes freezing tendrils at a foe.
Icy Tendrils of Ikthalon.effect: The character makes an Ego check against the Agility defense of a target in their line of sight. If the attack is a success, it inflicts regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double that total damage and is paralyzed by the ice.
Icy Tendrils of Ikthalon.short_effect:
Ego vs. Agility (line of sight, 10 spaces)
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and paralyzed

Illumination.name: Illumination
Illumination.description: The character creates a bright light.
Illumination.effect: The character illuminates one object or point in line of sight, within 50 spaces, with bright light. The character can maintain concentration on the effect even if they move out of range or line of sight.
Illumination.short_effect:
Bright light on object/point (line of sight, 50 spaces)
Maintain even if out of range/sight

Images of Ikonn.name: Images of Ikonn
Images of Ikonn.description: The character creates illusory duplicates of a person.
Images of Ikonn.effect: The character creates one sound and sight illusory duplicate per rank of one person they've met (including themselves). The duplicates look and sound exactly like the original and are under the character's complete control. They start in the same space as the character and instantly move into any open space around them, up to 2 spaces away, during which time the character can swap places with any of the duplicates. If the character is duplicating themselves, the character's player should secretly record which one is the actual character. The duplicates can move up to 10 spaces away from the character, and they can pretend to attack (and miss) opponents. Any attack that hits a duplicate instantly removes it. If the character successfully attacks someone or does something else to make the truth evident, the illusion ends. This spell can also be used to see through someone else's illusion. When used in this way, it gives the character a double edge on their Ego check.
Images of Ikonn.short_effect:
Create duplicates (1 per rank) of person you've met
• Start in your space, move to 2 spaces away (can swap places during)
• Move up to 10 spaces from you; can fake attacks
• Hit removes duplicate; illusion ends if you truly attack
• OR: Double edge on Ego check vs. someone else's illusion

Immovable.name: Immovable
Immovable.trigger: The character is knocked back or knocked prone.
Immovable.effect: For every point of Melee defense the character has, they can reduce knockback by 1 space.
Immovable.short_effect: Reaction: Reduce knockback by 1 space per point of Melee defense

Information Upload.name: Information Upload
Information Upload.description: The character can transmit loads of information straight into another's mind.
Information Upload.effect: The character transmits a knowledge-based label (a trait or tag) of their own to a target with whom they have established a telepathic link-willing or not. The label lasts until the target sleeps. The character can also impart any other kind of knowledge they have to a target this way. The process is almost instantaneous.
Information Upload.short_effect:
Transmit trait/tag/knowledge to telepathic link target (willing or not)
Lasts until target sleeps

Inspiration.name: Inspiration
Inspiration.description: The character's words inspire their allies.
Inspiration.effect: The character inspires an ally in earshot. The ally gains an edge on all action checks until the start of the character's next turn.
Inspiration.short_effect: Ally in earshot gains edge on all checks until start of your next turn

Instant Replay.name: Instant Replay
Instant Replay.effect: Once per battle, the character can make a second attempt at a check that they just failed, erasing and replacing the first attempt entirely.
Instant Replay.short_effect: Once per battle: Retry failed check (erase first attempt)

Integrity.name: Integrity
Integrity.description: The character can think their way through.
Integrity.effect: The character can use their Logic defense score against Ego attacks too.
Integrity.short_effect: Use Logic defense vs. Ego attacks

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description: The character turns as transparent as glass.
Invisibility.effect: The character becomes invisible. They have an edge on Agility checks to sneak past people, and enemies have trouble on Vigilance checks to perceive them. It's even harder to spot things that are invisible but aren't moving. Characters must be actively trying to do so to be able to make a Vigilance check.
Invisibility.short_effect:
Become invisible
Edge on Agility to sneak; enemies have trouble on Vigilance to perceive you

Jinx.name: Jinx
Jinx.description: The character puts a jinx on a foe.
Jinx.effect: The character makes an Ego check against the target's Ego defense. If it succeeds, the target has trouble on all actions. On a Fantastic success, the target loses their next standard action.
Jinx.short_effect:
Ego vs. Ego
• Success: Target has trouble on all actions
• Fantastic: Also lose next standard action

Jump 1.name: Jump 1
Jump 1.description: The character can leap about like a frog.
Jump 1.effect: The character gains the Jump movement mode with a Jump Speed equal to their Run Speed. They can jump this distance in any direction, vertically as well as horizontally.
Jump 1.short_effect:
Gain Jump movement mode; Jump Speed = Run Speed
Jump in any direction (vertical or horizontal)

Jump 2.name: Jump 2
Jump 2.description: The character can leap around with dazzling speed.
Jump 2.effect: The character's Jump Speed is equal to their rank times their Run Speed. Outside of combat, they can move three times as fast.
Jump 2.short_effect:
Jump Speed = rank × Run Speed
Outside combat: 3× Jump Speed

Jump 3.name: Jump 3
Jump 3.description: The character can leap into the sky with a single bound.
Jump 3.effect: Outside of combat, the character can jump up to 50 times their Jump Speed.
Jump 3.short_effect: Outside combat: Jump up to 50× Jump Speed

Keep Moving.name: Keep Moving
Keep Moving.description: The character can keep allies moving under fire.
Keep Moving.trigger: An ally in line of sight and earshot is demoralized or stunned.
Keep Moving.effect: The demoralized or stunned condition ends.

Kill Zone.name: Kill Zone
Kill Zone.description: The character shoots at every target that moves through their kill zone.
Kill Zone.trigger: An enemy in the character's line of sight starts to move.
Kill Zone.effect: The character makes a ranged attack on the enemy. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes normal damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage. Either way, the character regains their reaction. Each target can be affected by this attack by this character only once per round.
Kill Zone.short_effect:
Ranged attack (reaction)
• Success: Regular damage and regain reaction
• Fantastic: 2× damage and regain reaction
Each target affected only once per round

Leaping Leglock.name: Leaping Leglock
Leaping Leglock.description: The character leaps into the air and snaps their legs around an enemy.
Leaping Leglock.effect: The character makes a close attack against an enemy. If the attack is a success, the enemy is grabbed and dealt regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage and is grabbed and stunned for one round. Either way, both the character and the enemy are knocked prone.
Leaping Leglock.short_effect:
Close attack
• Success: Regular damage, grab enemy, both knocked prone
• Fantastic: 2× damage, grab, stun for 1 round, both knocked prone

Leech Life.name: Leech Life
Leech Life.description: The character consumes the life force of another.
Leech Life.effect: The character makes an Ego attack against the target's Resilience defense. If it succeeds, the target takes regular Health damage, and the character heals half that much Health for themselves. On a Fantastic success, the character heals the full Health damage instead.
Leech Life.short_effect:
Ego vs. Resilience (reaction)
• Success: Target takes Health damage, heal ½ that amount
• Fantastic: Target takes Health damage, heal full amount

Leg Sweep.name: Leg Sweep
Leg Sweep.description: The character knocks the enemy's legs from under them.
Leg Sweep.effect: The character makes a close attack. If it succeeds, the enemy takes regular damage and is knocked prone. If it's a Fantastic success, the enemy is stunned for one round too.
Leg Sweep.short_effect:
Close attack
• Success: Regular damage and knocked prone
• Fantastic: Regular damage, knocked prone, and stunned for 1 round

Levitation.name: Levitation
Levitation.description: The character can hover and move.
Levitation.effect: The character can move through the air in any direction at their Run Speed.
Levitation.short_effect: Move through air in any direction at Run Speed

Lightning Actions.name: Lightning Actions
Lightning Actions.effect: The character has one extra standard action and one extra reaction each turn. Additionally, they can turn their Marvel die to a Fantastic success when making an initiative check.
Lightning Actions.short_effect:
+1 standard action and +1 reaction per turn
Turn Marvel die to Fantastic on initiative checks

Machine Telepathy.name: Machine Telepathy
Machine Telepathy.description: The character can communicate with machines with their mind.
Machine Telepathy.effect: The character can communicate telepathically with one machine at a time, and they must have met or seen the machine before. The communication can be verbal, visual or even more complex, such as imparting location information. There is no limit to the distance of the communication, as long as the character and the machine are in the same dimension. Simple machines do not have much to offer in the way of conversation, but they are also generally compliant with requests. Complex machines-like computers, smartphones and other electronics-are also often compliant, but if they are secured in any way, they usually refuse to communicate with strangers. A Logic check can get the character past such security, and the Narrator should set the target number according to the strength of the security.
Machine Telepathy.short_effect:
Communicate telepathically with met/seen machine (any distance, same dimension)
Force link: Logic vs. Vigilance (rules same as Telepathic Link)

Macrodimensional Travel.name: Macrodimensional Travel
Macrodimensional Travel.effect: The character can grow enough to travel into the Macroverse, the Overspace or other dimensions of enlarged space. They can return to their normal size at will. Note that this is something that most characters would rarely want to do, as it removes them entirely from their regular universe and places them in a dimension in which the rules of time and space work differently. An hour in the Macroverse, for example, is roughly equivalent to a month in a regular universe. A trip to the Overspace is too overwhelming for most minds to handle.
Macrodimensional Travel.short_effect:
Grow to travel into Macroverse/Overspace/enlarged dimensions
Return to normal size at will

Memory Blip.name: Memory Blip
Memory Blip.description: The character erases a bit of someone's memory.
Memory Blip.effect: The character causes a target with whom they've established a Telepathic Link to forget something that's happened in the past hour. This gap can be up to an hour in length. The character makes a Logic check against the target's Logic defense. On a success, the memories are forgotten. On a Fantastic success, the target has trouble on checks to recover such memories in the future. Any time the target is given good reason to question the blank in their memory, they can make a Logic check to recover their memory. If they succeed, the original memory floods back. On a Fantastic success, they know for sure who did this to them.
Memory Blip.short_effect:
Logic vs. Logic (telepathic link target)
• Success: Forget up to 1 hour in past hour
• Fantastic: Trouble to recover
Target can Logic check to recover if given reason to question gap

Mental Punch.name: Mental Punch
Mental Punch.description: The character can blast a foe's mind in melee.
Mental Punch.effect: The character makes a Melee attack against a target. If the attack is a success, it inflicts regular Focus damage (instead of Health damage). On a Fantastic success, the target takes double damage instead and is stunned for one round.
Mental Punch.short_effect:
Melee attack (deals Focus damage instead of Health damage)
• Success: Regular Focus damage
• Fantastic: 2× Focus damage and stunned for 1 round

Mental Shelter.name: Mental Shelter
Mental Shelter.description: The character can create a shelter for their mind.
Mental Shelter.effect: The character extends their mental defenses to protect any chosen people within up to 5 spaces times their rank. The protected targets are granted Focus Damage Reduction equal to the character's Uncanny power.
Mental Shelter.short_effect:
Protect chosen targets (5 spaces × rank)
Targets gain Focus Damage Reduction = your Uncanny power level

Microdimensional Travel.name: Microdimensional Travel
Microdimensional Travel.description: The character shrinks out of the universe!
Microdimensional Travel.effect: The character can shrink enough to travel into subatomic realms. They can return to their normal size at will. Note that this is something that most characters would rarely want to do, as it removes them entirely from their regular universe and places them in a dimension in which the rules of time and space work differently. The Underspace, for example, might make a fine place to hide, but there's little else of interest there.
Microdimensional Travel.short_effect:
Shrink to travel into subatomic realms
Return to normal size at will

Mighty 1.name: Mighty 1
Mighty 1.effect: Treat the character as one size bigger for lifting, carrying, swinging and throwing things. They also add +1 to their Melee damage multiplier, and they gain a +1 bonus to Melee checks other than attacks.
Mighty 1.short_effect: +1 size for lifting/carrying/swinging/throwing; +1 Melee damage multiplier; +1 to non-attack Melee checks

Mighty 2.name: Mighty 2
Mighty 2.description: The character could lift a bus.
Mighty 2.effect: Treat the character as two sizes bigger for lifting, carrying, swinging and throwing things. They also add +2 to their Melee damage multiplier, and they gain a +2 bonus to Melee checks other than attacks.
Mighty 2.short_effect: +2 sizes for lifting/carrying/swinging/throwing; +2 Melee damage multiplier; +2 to non-attack Melee checks

Mighty 3.name: Mighty 3
Mighty 3.description: The character could lift a house.
Mighty 3.effect: Treat the character as three sizes bigger for lifting, carrying, swinging and throwing things. They also add +3 to their Melee damage multiplier, and they gain a +3 bonus to Melee checks other than attacks.
Mighty 3.short_effect: +3 sizes for lifting/carrying/swinging/throwing; +3 Melee damage multiplier; +3 to non-attack Melee checks

Mighty 4.name: Mighty 4
Mighty 4.description: The character is among the strongest there are.
Mighty 4.effect: Treat the character as four sizes bigger lifting, carrying, swinging and throwing things. They also add +4 to their Melee damage multiplier, and they gain a +4 bonus to Melee checks other than attacks.
Mighty 4.short_effect: +4 sizes for lifting/carrying/swinging/throwing; +4 Melee damage multiplier; +4 to non-attack Melee checks

Mind Interrogation.name: Mind Interrogation
Mind Interrogation.description: The character can root through a target's mind.
Mind Interrogation.effect: The character can delve into the mind of a single person with whom they have established a telepathic link. This requires a Logic check against the target's Logic defense. On a success, the character can ask a single simple question and get the answer from the target's mind. On a Fantastic success, the character can get more complex information.
Mind Interrogation.short_effect:
Logic vs. Logic (telepathic link target)
• Success: Ask simple question, get answer
• Fantastic: Get complex information

Mind Reading.name: Mind Reading
Mind Reading.effect: The character can read the thoughts of a single person with whom they have established a Telepathic Link. This requires a Logic check against the target's Logic defense. On a success, the character can read the target's surface thoughts. On a Fantastic success, the character can ask a single simple question and get the answer from the target's mind.
Mind Reading.short_effect:
Logic vs. Logic (telepathic link target)
• Success: Read surface thoughts
• Fantastic: Ask simple question, get answer

Mirage.name: Mirage
Mirage.description: The character can make mirages appear in a target's mind.
Mirage.effect: The character creates a full-sensory mirage that affects any target with whom they have established a link. The mirage can be of anything the character desires, and it can move freely.
Mirage.short_effect:
Full-sensory mirage for telepathic link target
Moves freely

Mirror Images.name: Mirror Images
Mirror Images.description: The character conjures up illusory duplicates of themselves.
Mirror Images.effect: The character creates one sound and sight illusory duplicate of themselves per rank. The duplicates look and sound exactly like them and are under their complete control. They start in the same space as the character and instantly move into any open space around them, up to 2 spaces away, during which time the character can swap places with any of the duplicates. The character's player should secretly record which one is the actual character. The duplicates can move up to 10 spaces away from the character, and they can pretend to attack (and miss) opponents. Any attack that hits a duplicate instantly removes it. If the character successfully attacks someone or does something else to make the truth evident, the illusion ends.
Mirror Images.short_effect:
Create duplicates of yourself (1 per rank)
• Start in your space, move to 2 spaces away (can swap places during)
• Move up to 10 spaces from you; can fake attacks
• Hit removes duplicate; illusion ends if you truly attack

Mists of Morpheus.name: Mists of Morpheus
Mists of Morpheus.description: The character causes their foe to fall asleep.
Mists of Morpheus.effect: The character makes an Ego check against the target's Vigilance defense. On a success, the target is stunned and remains that way while the character concentrates. On a Fantastic success, the target falls asleep instead.
Mists of Morpheus.short_effect:
Ego vs. Vigilance
• Success: Stunned while you concentrate
• Fantastic: Falls asleep

Mists of Munnopor.name: Mists of Munnopor
Mists of Munnopor.description: The character weaves a thick fog.
Mists of Munnopor.effect: The character creates a thick fog for up to 100 spaces per rank around them that blocks all line of sight beyond 10 spaces and keeps people or creatures inside it from flying, gliding or webslinging.
Mists of Munnopor.short_effect:
Thick fog (100 spaces/rank); blocks line of sight beyond 10 spaces
Prevents creatures from entering fog (Ego vs. Vigilance to keep out)

Molecular Destabilization.name: Molecular Destabilization
Molecular Destabilization.description: The character causes something to vibrate fast enough to explode.
Molecular Destabilization.effect: The character makes a close attack against an object their size or smaller. If the attack is a success, the object explodes. All targets within 2 spaces of the object-other than the character-take regular damage. On a Fantastic success, double the damage and ignore any Health Damage Reduction.
Molecular Destabilization.short_effect:
Close attack vs. object (your size or smaller)
• Success: Object explodes; all within 2 spaces take damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and ignore Health Damage Reduction

Multiversal Portal.name: Multiversal Portal
Multiversal Portal.description: The character opens a portal to another universe.
Multiversal Portal.effect: The character opens a glowing portal in a space next to them that moves anything that enters it between that space and its destination, which forms a matched glowing portal in the other place. The other end of the portal must be in a clear space in another universe that the character has been to. Anything can move through the portal in either direction until it is closed, which the character can do at will.
Multiversal Portal.short_effect:
Open two-way portal to another universe (must have visited)
Anything can travel through in either direction; close at will

Multiversal Travel.name: Multiversal Travel
Multiversal Travel.description: The character moves from one universe to another.
Multiversal Travel.effect: The character instantly moves from their current universe to another universe. For instance: from Earth-616 to Earth-65. When they move to the other universe, they can arrive in any place they've been to before. Otherwise, they arrive at the closest available corresponding space in the other universe.
Multiversal Travel.short_effect:
Instantly travel to another universe
Arrive at place you've visited, or closest corresponding space

Multiversal Travel Other.name: Multiversal Travel Other
Multiversal Travel Other.description: The character sends someone to another universe.
Multiversal Travel Other.effect: The character makes an Ego check against the Vigilance of a target they have grabbed. If the check is successful, the character can send the target to another universe. The target can be sent to any location in that universe that the character has been to before. Otherwise, the target arrives at the closest available corresponding space in the other universe.
Multiversal Travel Other.short_effect:
Ego vs. Vigilance (grabbed target)
• Success: Send target to another universe (place you've visited or closest corresponding space)

Multiversal Travel Together.name: Multiversal Travel Together
Multiversal Travel Together.description: The character brings someone with them to another universe.
Multiversal Travel Together.effect: The character moves to a different universe, taking any person they are touching with them. If the target does not wish to come along, the character must grab them first. When they move to the other universe, they can arrive in any place they've been to before. Otherwise, they arrive at the closest available corresponding space in the other universe.
Multiversal Travel Together.short_effect:
Travel to another universe with person you're touching (must grab unwilling target)
Arrive at place you've visited, or closest corresponding space

On Your Feet.name: On Your Feet
On Your Feet.description: The character stands their friends on their feet.
On Your Feet.trigger: An ally in line of sight and earshot is knocked prone.
On Your Feet.effect: All prone allies within earshot, who are able to, can immediately stand up for free. Allies currently unable to stand up for any reason are not affected.
On Your Feet.short_effect: All prone allies in earshot (who are able) stand up for free

Operations Center.name: Operations Center
Operations Center.description: The character directs their allies in combat.
Operations Center.effect: The character inspires one or more allies of their choice in earshot, up to the character's Vigilance defense. Affected allies gain an edge on all action checks until the start of the character's next turn. The character breaks concentration on this power if they use a movement action.
Operations Center.short_effect:
Allies in earshot (up to Vigilance) gain edge on all checks until start of your next turn
Breaks if you use movement action

Orchestra of Overkill.name: Orchestra of Overkill
Orchestra of Overkill.description: The character conducts a symphony of shooting.
Orchestra of Overkill.effect: The character makes an Agility check and compares that against the Agility defense of every enemy within 10 spaces and in their line of sight. Each success does half regular damage. On a Fantastic success, each enemy takes full damage instead and is bleeding.
Orchestra of Overkill.short_effect:
Agility vs. all enemies within 10 spaces (line of sight)
• Success: Each takes ½ damage
• Fantastic: Each takes full damage and bleeding

Orders.name: Orders
Orders.description: The character forces someone to follow a complex set of orders.
Orders.effect: The character gives an order to a target with whom they've established a Telepathic Link and who has no Focus left. The character makes a Logic check against the target's Logic defense. On a success, the target complies with the orders. On a Fantastic success, the character gains an edge the next time they use this power against this same target. The command must be to do something that can be completed in an hour or less. If it involves harming someone, the character has trouble on the check. If it would cause the target to harm themselves, the character has double trouble on the check.
Orders.short_effect:
Logic vs. Logic (telepathic link target with 0 Focus)
• Success: Obey ≤1 hour command (Fantastic: edge next time)
Harm someone: Trouble; harm self: Double trouble

Partial Phase.name: Partial Phase
Partial Phase.description: The character can make a portion of themselves tangible or intangible.
Partial Phase.effect: The character has greater control over their phasing ability. They can make any portion of their body and clothing tangible or intangible, as they like.
Partial Phase.short_effect: Make any body part/clothing tangible or intangible selectively

Penance Stare.name: Penance Stare
Penance Stare.description: The character can punish the wicked with their gaze.
Penance Stare.effect: The character makes an Ego attack against a target character within 3 spaces per rank. If it's a success, the target takes Focus damage. On a Fantastic success, the target takes double damage and is paralyzed for one round. Characters with the Heroic tag take half the listed damage from this power in either case. If a target is shattered by this power, they can recover, but they come back in one of two ways. Either they are cleansed of their sins and ready to make a new start with a clean slate, or their emotions are drained from them permanently. How this works in each case is up to the Narrator.
Penance Stare.short_effect:
Ego attack (3 spaces × rank)
• Success: Focus damage (½ damage if Heroic tag)
• Fantastic: 2× Focus damage and paralyzed for 1 round (½ damage if Heroic tag)
If shattered: Cleansed of sins OR emotions permanently drained

Phase Object.name: Phase Object
Phase Object.description: The character can make something they're touching intangible.
Phase Object.effect: The character can make any object they are touching intangible. The object (and things attached to or inside of it) can be up to their rank in sizes bigger than them. For example, if they are Rank 5, the object can be 5 sizes bigger than them. For an average person, this would be Gargantuan.
Phase Object.short_effect: Make touched object intangible (up to rank sizes bigger than you)

Phase Other.name: Phase Other
Phase Other.description: The character can phase someone they are touching.
Phase Other.effect: The character can make any person (and their clothing) they are touching intangible. The character can also phase any people the initial person is touching or grabbing. People the character has phased remain tangible to each other. If the target does not wish to be phased, the character must grab them first. When contact is broken, the phasing for those no longer in contact with the character (even indirectly) ends. If a person is inside something when they stop phasing, they are automatically pushed out of it but take damage from the disruption equal to a standard action check. The damage multiplier is 1 for every space they must move to reach a clear area. If this kills them, their body is trapped inside the material they were phased into.
Phase Other.short_effect:
Make touched person intangible (can chain to people they touch; grab unwilling targets)
Remain tangible to each other; ends when contact breaks
If inside object when phasing ends: Pushed out, take damage (multiplier = spaces moved; death traps body)

Phase Self.name: Phase Self
Phase Self.description: The character can become as intangible as a ghost.
Phase Self.effect: The character (and their clothing) becomes intangible and can move through anything as if it wasn't there. Nothing can physically affect them, nor can they affect anything else that is not phasing along with them.
Phase Self.short_effect:
You and clothing become intangible
Move through anything; nothing affects you; can't affect anything

Phase Walk.name: Phase Walk
Phase Walk.description: The character can walk on air.
Phase Walk.effect: When phasing, the character can move freely in any direction through anything-not just air, but also water, buildings and so on-at their Run Speed. The character can take anything or anyone they are phasing along with them.
Phase Walk.short_effect:
While phasing: Move freely through anything (air, water, buildings) at Run Speed
Leave solid matter: Pushed out if inside, take damage (multiplier = spaces moved; death traps body)

Point-Blank Parry.name: Point-Blank Parry
Point-Blank Parry.description: When the enemy steps in, the character lets loose.
Point-Blank Parry.trigger: An enemy within 2 spaces misses an attack against the character.
Point-Blank Parry.effect: The character makes a ranged attack against the enemy who missed them. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage and is bleeding.
Point-Blank Parry.short_effect:
Ranged attack (reaction when enemy misses you)
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and bleeding

Possess Vehicle.name: Possess Vehicle
Possess Vehicle.description: The character takes control of a vehicle.
Possess Vehicle.effect: The character takes magical control of a vehicle they are inside of or touching. Hellfire engulfs the outside of the vehicle, but it does no damage to it. Anyone that comes into contact with it, though, takes regular damage with a damage multiplier equal to the character's rank. On a Fantastic success, it inflicts regular Health damage and regular Focus damage instead. The character controls the vehicle by will, as long as it is within 20 spaces times the character's rank. They use their Ego for all checks to operate it, and they get an edge on all such checks. The vehicle's speed doubles. It can climb walls at this speed and can even make jumps at that same speed.
Possess Vehicle.short_effect:
Take magical control of vehicle (inside or touching)
• Hellfire engulfs it: Contact deals damage (multiplier = rank; Fantastic: Health + Focus damage)
• Control via Ego with edge within 20 spaces × rank
• Speed doubled; can climb walls and jump at that speed

Possession.name: Possession
Possession.description: The character takes over someone else's body.
Possession.effect: The character makes an Ego check with trouble against the Ego defense of a character who has no Focus left. On a success, the character takes over the target's body completely. The character's Ego defense is the target number for any checks to end the possession. If the character attempts to harm someone with the possessed body, the target gets to make an Ego check to end the possession. If the target has the Heroic tag, they get an edge on the check. If the character attempts to harm the possessed body, the target gets an edge on the check. If they have the Heroic tag, they get a double edge.
Possession.short_effect:
Ego with trouble vs. Ego (target with 0 Focus)
• Success: Take over body (your check = TN to end)
Harm someone: Target checks to end (Heroic: edge; harm self: double edge)

Powerful Hex.name: Powerful Hex
Powerful Hex.description: The character simulates another power with their magic.
Powerful Hex.effect: The character casts a hex that allows them to use any other power that they have the rank to use, even if they would not normally meet the power's other prerequisites. They must pay whatever the regular Focus cost is for that power, plus 5 Focus. If the duration of the used power is permanent, it is concentration for the character instead. If the power is a numbered permanent power (like Mighty 3), the Focus cost is 5 times that number instead. (Mighty 3 would cost 15 Focus.)
Powerful Hex.short_effect: Use any power you have rank for (ignore other prerequisites)

Probability-Manipulation Hex.name: Probability-Manipulation Hex
Probability-Manipulation Hex.description: The character makes unlikely things happen.
Probability-Manipulation Hex.effect: When an ally within 5 spaces times the character's rank attempts a check on which they have trouble, this hex eliminates all trouble and gives them an edge instead.
Probability-Manipulation Hex.short_effect: Eliminate ally's trouble (5 spaces × rank) and give them edge

Protection Hex.name: Protection Hex
Protection Hex.description: The character casts a hex to protect themselves.
Protection Hex.effect: The character produces a hex to help protect themselves. Make an Ego check. The result is now the character's defense against any attack. If the result isn't as high as the character would like, they can end the hex and try again later. On a Fantastic success, the hex also grants Health Damage Reduction 1 for its duration.
Protection Hex.short_effect:
Ego check result becomes your defense vs. all attacks
Can end and retry if unsatisfied
• Fantastic: Also gain Health Damage Reduction 1

Quick Phase.name: Quick Phase
Quick Phase.description: The character can become as intangible as a ghost.
Quick Phase.effect: The character and their clothing can instantly become intangible.
Quick Phase.short_effect: You and clothing instantly become intangible

Quick Toss.name: Quick Toss
Quick Toss.description: The character tosses a person like a toy.
Quick Toss.trigger: A person the character can pick up is grabbed.
Quick Toss.effect: The character throws the grabbed person at another target. The range is determined by the level of the character's Mighty power and the grabbed person's size. The character makes a ranged attack against the target. A failure inflicts regular damage on the thrown person, who falls prone within 1 space of the target. If the attack is a success, the target takes regular damage too. On a Fantastic success, the target is knocked prone as well.
Quick Toss.short_effect:
Throw grabbed person at target (reaction; range = Mighty level + size)
Ranged attack
• Failure: Thrown person takes damage and falls prone within 1 space of target
• Success: Target also takes damage
• Fantastic: Target takes damage and knocked prone

Rally on Me.name: Rally on Me
Rally on Me.description: The character rallies their friends around them.
Rally on Me.effect: Any allies in earshot can be affected, up to a number equal to the character's Vigilance. Each affected ally can move toward the character at half speed. If they are within the character's reach at the end of this move, they recover lost Focus equal to 5 times the character's rank. The character can use this power once per battle.
Rally on Me.short_effect: Allies in earshot (up to Vigilance) can move toward you at ½ speed

Regain Focus.name: Regain Focus
Regain Focus.description: The character takes a moment to find their center.
Regain Focus.effect: The character recovers Focus equal to their Vigilance.

Reinforced Skeleton.name: Reinforced Skeleton
Reinforced Skeleton.description: The character's bones have been reinforced or replaced with a super-strong alloy or metal.
Reinforced Skeleton.effect: The character gains Health Damage Reduction 1.

Resize Object.name: Resize Object
Resize Object.description: The character can change the size of an object within reach.
Resize Object.effect: The character can make an object within reach grow or shrink. The character can resize the object as much as their own Grow or Shrink power would allow them to.
Resize Object.short_effect: Grow/shrink object within reach (as much as your Grow/Shrink power allows)

Resize Other.name: Resize Other
Resize Other.description: The character can resize someone they are touching.
Resize Other.effect: The character can resize any person (and their clothing) they are touching. The character can resize the object as much as their own Grow or Shrink power would allow them to. If the target does not wish to be resized, the character must grab them first.
Resize Other.short_effect:
Grow/shrink touched person and clothing (as much as your Grow/Shrink power allows)
Must grab unwilling target

Return Fire.name: Return Fire
Return Fire.description: The character responds to an assault with a hail of shots.
Return Fire.trigger: An enemy declares an attack against the character.
Return Fire.effect: The character makes an Agility attack against a target's Vigilance defense. If the attack is a success, apply Health Damage Reduction normally. Any damage taken is then applied to the target's Focus instead. If it's a Fantastic success, the damage is doubled and, if the target takes any Focus damage, they are stunned for 1 round.
Return Fire.short_effect:
Agility vs. Vigilance (reaction)
• Success: Damage (after reduction) goes to target's Focus instead of your Health
• Fantastic: 2× damage to Focus and stunned for 1 round

Reverse Punch.name: Reverse Punch
Reverse Punch.description: The character can reach past an enemy and punch them from behind.
Reverse Punch.effect: The character makes a close attack with an edge on an enemy. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage and is stunned for one round.
Reverse Punch.short_effect:
Close attack with edge
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and stunned for 1 round

Reverse-Momentum Throw.name: Reverse-Momentum Throw
Reverse-Momentum Throw.description: The character uses the momentum of their attacker to hurl them to the ground.
Reverse-Momentum Throw.trigger: While Defense Stance is active, a close attack against the character misses.
Reverse-Momentum Throw.effect: The attacker is knocked prone and takes half the damage their attack would have inflicted if it had succeeded.
Reverse-Momentum Throw.short_effect: Reaction: Attacker knocked prone and takes ½ the damage their attack would have inflicted

Rico-Shield.name: Rico-Shield
Rico-Shield.description: The character ricochets their shield from target to target.
Rico-Shield.effect: The character makes a ranged attack on a target. If the attack is a success, the target takes regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the target is also knocked prone, and the character can make an extra attack on another target, adding the extra range between the two targets to the new attack roll. This can be repeated until an attack is not a Fantastic success. When the attacks are over, the shield then bounces back to the character.
Rico-Shield.short_effect:
Ranged attack (10 spaces × rank)
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: Regular damage, knocked prone, and chain to next target (repeat until non-Fantastic)
Shield returns to you

Riposte.name: Riposte
Riposte.description: Seeing the enemy off balance, the character strikes back.
Riposte.trigger: An enemy makes a close attack against the character that fails.
Riposte.effect: The character makes a close attack on the enemy who just missed them. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage and suffers the weapon's special effect.
Riposte.short_effect:
Close attack (reaction when enemy misses you)
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and weapon special effect

Rubberneck.name: Rubberneck
Rubberneck.description: The character can lengthen and twist their neck.
Rubberneck.effect: The character can move their head away from their body, up to their reach, to establish a line of sight to a target.
Rubberneck.short_effect: Move head away from body (up to reach) to establish line of sight

Run on Water.name: Run on Water
Run on Water.description: The character can run across water.
Run on Water.effect: The character can run so that their feet skip across the surface of water. As long as they keep running (even in place), they do not sink.
Run on Water.short_effect:
Skip across water surface while running
Don't sink as long as you keep running

Scatter.name: Scatter
Scatter.description: The character warns allies to take evasive action.
Scatter.trigger: An enemy in line of sight declares an attack on an ally within earshot.
Scatter.effect: Any allies in earshot can be affected, up to a number equal to the character's rank. Each affected ally can move away from you at half Speed and then fall prone. If this makes the ally an ineligible target for the initial attack, that attack automatically fails.
Scatter.short_effect:
Reaction: Allies in earshot (up to rank) can move away at ½ Speed and fall prone
If prone makes them ineligible target, attack auto-fails

Sense Sins.name: Sense Sins
Sense Sins.description: The character can look into a person's soul.
Sense Sins.effect: The character looks into a target's eyes and makes an Ego check against the target's Ego defense. On a success, the character can sense what sorts of horrible things the target has done. On a Fantastic success, they can sense what sorts of horrible things the target intends to do in the immediate future.
Sense Sins.short_effect:
Ego vs. Ego (look into target's eyes)
• Success: Sense horrible things they've done
• Fantastic: Also sense horrible things they intend to do

Sense Supernatural.name: Sense Supernatural
Sense Supernatural.description: The character can sense the supernatural.
Sense Supernatural.effect: The character can reach out with their mind to sense the presence of supernatural people, places or things within 100 spaces per rank. This tells them the location of the supernatural thing and its general status. If a target or targets wish to remain undetected, the character must make an Ego check and compare it against each target's Vigilance defense. If they succeed, they sense the target. On a Fantastic success, they can also identify if the target is cursed or demonic.
Sense Supernatural.short_effect:
Sense supernatural presence (100 spaces/rank): location, status
Unwilling targets: Ego vs. Vigilance (Fantastic: identify if cursed/demonic)

Shape-Shift.name: Shape-Shift
Shape-Shift.trigger: The character is attacked or otherwise in danger.
Shape-Shift.effect: The character can change into another form no more than one size bigger or smaller than their regular form. When in any form, the character has access to the natural abilities of that form. For instance, if they transformed into a bird, they could fly. When transformed into a fish, they can breathe water.
Shape-Shift.short_effect:
Change into form (±1 size)
Retain powers but stats/defenses/traits/tags change to match new form
Concentration; any successful attack breaks it

Shield 1.name: Shield 1
Shield 1.description: The character wields a personal shield.
Shield 1.effect: The character gains Health Damage Reduction 1.

Shield 2.name: Shield 2
Shield 2.description: The character's shield protects them like a wall.
Shield 2.effect: The character gains Health Damage Reduction 2.

Shield 3.name: Shield 3
Shield 3.description: The character's shield protects better than a tank.
Shield 3.effect: The character gains Health Damage Reduction 3.

Shield 4.name: Shield 4
Shield 4.description: The character's shield protects like a concrete barrier.
Shield 4.effect: The character gains Health Damage Reduction 4.

Shield Bash.name: Shield Bash
Shield Bash.description: The character bashes a foe with their shield.
Shield Bash.effect: The character makes a close attack on an enemy within their reach. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage and is knocked prone.
Shield Bash.short_effect:
Close attack
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and knocked prone

Shield Deflection.name: Shield Deflection
Shield Deflection.description: The character uses their shield to deflect attacks.
Shield Deflection.trigger: The character is the target of an attack against their Agility defense.
Shield Deflection.short_effect: Reaction: Attack vs. you has trouble

Shield of the Seraphim.name: Shield of the Seraphim
Shield of the Seraphim.description: The character produces a magical shield.
Shield of the Seraphim.effect: The character produces a magical shield that protects them from physical damage. Any attacks against them that do 20 points of damage or less are instantly absorbed, and the protection continues. If an attack does more than 20 points of damage, it destroys the protection. Either way, the character remains unharmed.
Shield of the Seraphim.short_effect: Absorb attacks ≤20 damage; destroyed if >20 damage; you remain unharmed either way

Shield Wall.name: Shield Wall
Shield Wall.description: The character stands like an impenetrable wall.
Shield Wall.effect: Attacks against the character have trouble. The character breaks concentration on this power if they use a movement action.
Shield Wall.short_effect:
Attacks vs. you have trouble
Breaks concentration if you use movement action

Shrink 1.name: Shrink 1
Shrink 1.effect: The character can shrink down to little size. They can return to their normal size at will.
Shrink 1.short_effect:
Shrink to Little size
Return to normal at will

Shrink 2.name: Shrink 2
Shrink 2.effect: The character can shrink down to tiny size. They can return to their normal size at will.
Shrink 2.short_effect:
Shrink to Tiny size
Return to normal at will

Shrink 3.name: Shrink 3
Shrink 3.description: The character is smaller than an action figure.
Shrink 3.effect: The character can shrink down to miniature size. They can return to their normal size at will.
Shrink 3.short_effect:
Shrink to Miniature size
Return to normal at will

Shrink 4.name: Shrink 4
