Shrink 4.description: The character is so small that they're hard to see.
Shrink 4.effect: The character can shrink down to microscopic size. They can return to their normal size at will.
Shrink 4.short_effect:
Shrink to Microscopic size
Return to normal at will

Shrinking Dodge.name: Shrinking Dodge
Shrinking Dodge.description: The character shrinks to avoid an attack.
Shrinking Dodge.effect: The attacker has trouble on the attack.
Shrinking Dodge.short_effect: Reaction: Attacker has trouble on attack

Shut Down Powers.name: Shut Down Powers
Shut Down Powers.description: The character removes all of a target's powers!
Shut Down Powers.effect: The character picks another character within 20 spaces and makes an Ego attack against them. On a success, they remove all of a target's powers. If the target's powers have costs, the character must pay the highest of them, or a minimum of 15 Focus.
Shut Down Powers.short_effect:
Ego attack vs. target within 20 spaces
• Success: Remove all target's powers
• Cost: Target's highest power cost or 15 Focus minimum

Silence Area.name: Silence Area
Silence Area.description: An unnatural silence falls over the area.
Silence Area.effect: An area up to 5 spaces wide per the character's rank-centered on anything the character wishes, within 50 spaces-is filled with silence. Those inside the area cannot hear anything, and no one outside of it can hear any noises made inside it. The character must remain within 50 spaces of the area to avoid breaking concentration.
Silence Area.short_effect:
Silence (5 spaces/rank wide, within 50 spaces)
No sound in/out
Must stay within 50 spaces to maintain

Silence Self.name: Silence Self
Silence Self.effect: The character makes no noise at all-unless they wish to. They have an edge on Agility checks to sneak past people, and enemies have trouble on Vigilance checks to perceive them.
Silence Self.short_effect:
Make no noise (unless you wish)
Edge on Agility to sneak; enemies have trouble on Vigilance vs. you

Slip Free.name: Slip Free
Slip Free.description: The character is impossible to restrain.
Slip Free.trigger: The character is grabbed or pinned.
Slip Free.effect: The character is not grabbed or pinned.

Slow-Motion Dodge.name: Slow-Motion Dodge
Slow-Motion Dodge.description: Time seems to slow down for the character, making it easy to dodge enemy attacks.
Slow-Motion Dodge.trigger: An enemy makes an attack against the character's Agility defense.
Slow-Motion Dodge.effect: The enemy has trouble on the attack.
Slow-Motion Dodge.short_effect: Reaction: Enemy has trouble on attack

Slow-Motion Shoot-Dodge.name: Slow-Motion Shoot-Dodge
Slow-Motion Shoot-Dodge.description: The character dives sideways, weapons blazing, hanging in midair for a split second.
Slow-Motion Shoot-Dodge.effect: The character splits their attack to make two ranged attacks against separate targets (or they can focus a single attack on a single target). Make a single Agility check and compare it to the targets' Agility defenses. On a success, an affected target takes half regular damage. On a Fantastic success, an affected target takes full damage, and the character can make a bonus attack with this power against any available target, with the same effect. When the character moves, is moved, or starts their next turn, they instantly fall prone. Until that happens, all attacks against their Agility defense have trouble.
Slow-Motion Shoot-Dodge.short_effect:
Single Agility check vs. two targets (or one target)
• Success: Each takes ½ damage
• Fantastic: Each takes full damage, plus bonus attack vs. any target
All attacks vs. your Agility defense have trouble until you move/are moved/start next turn (then fall prone)

Smash.name: Smash
Smash.effect: The character makes a close attack with an edge. For this attack, add +1 to the character's Melee damage bonus for every 2 points of Focus they spend. On a success, an affected target takes that total damage. On a Fantastic success, an affected target takes double that total damage and is stunned for one round.
Smash.short_effect:
Close attack with edge
+1 Melee damage per 2 Focus spent
• Success: Total damage
• Fantastic: 2× total damage and stunned for 1 round

Snap Shooting.name: Snap Shooting
Snap Shooting.description: The character shoots from the hip with deadly speed.
Snap Shooting.effect: The character splits their attack to make two ranged attacks against separate targets (or they can focus a single attack on a single target). Make a single Agility check and compare it to the targets' Agility defenses. On a success, an affected target takes half regular damage. On a Fantastic success, an affected target takes full damage and is bleeding.
Snap Shooting.short_effect:
Single Agility check vs. two targets (or one target)
• Success: Each takes ½ damage
• Fantastic: Each takes full damage and bleeding

Sniping.name: Sniping
Sniping.description: The character takes aim and shoots with deadly accuracy.
Sniping.action: Both standard and movement (character cannot move this turn)
Sniping.effect: The character makes a ranged attack against an enemy at least 20 spaces away. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes triple damage instead.
Sniping.short_effect:
Ranged attack vs. enemy ≥20 spaces away (uses standard + movement; cannot move)
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 3× damage

Speed Blast.name: Speed Blast
Speed Blast.description: The character fans their arms fast enough to blast a target with a gust of air!
Speed Blast.effect: The character makes a ranged attack. If it succeeds, the target is stunned for one round. On a Fantastic success, the character is knocked prone too.
Speed Blast.short_effect:
Ranged attack (10 spaces)
• Success: Stun for 1 round
• Fantastic: Stun for 1 round and knocked prone

Speed Run 1.name: Speed Run 1
Speed Run 1.description: The character runs as fast as a car!
Speed Run 1.effect: Multiply the character's regular Run Speed by their rank to get their new Run Speed. Outside of combat, they can move three times as fast.
Speed Run 1.short_effect:
Run Speed = rank × normal Run Speed
Outside combat: 3× that speed

Speed Run 2.name: Speed Run 2
Speed Run 2.description: The character runs as fast as a jet!
Speed Run 2.effect: Outside of combat, the character can move up to 50 times as fast as their increased Run Speed.
Speed Run 2.short_effect: Outside combat: Run up to 50× increased Run Speed

Speed Swim.name: Speed Swim
Speed Swim.description: The character can swim faster than a dolphin!
Speed Swim.effect: Multiply the character's regular Swim Speed by their rank to get their new Swim Speed. Outside of combat, they can move three times as fast.
Speed Swim.short_effect:
Swim Speed = rank × normal Swim Speed
Outside combat: 3× that speed

Spider-Dodge.name: Spider-Dodge
Spider-Dodge.description: The character dodges attacks with a spiderlike scuttle.
Spider-Dodge.trigger: Someone makes an Agility attack against the character.
Spider-Dodge.effect: The attacker has trouble on the attack. If the attack misses, the character can leap in any direction at their Jump Speed.
Spider-Dodge.short_effect:
Reaction: Attacker has trouble
If attack misses: Leap in any direction at Jump Speed

Spider-Pheromones.name: Spider-Pheromones
Spider-Pheromones.description: The character exudes pheromones that affect those nearby.
Spider-Pheromones.effect: The character has an edge on Ego (intimidation) checks against people who are not attracted to their gender. They also have an edge on Ego (persuasion) checks against people who are attracted to their gender.
Spider-Pheromones.short_effect:
Edge on Ego (intimidation) vs. those not attracted to your gender
Edge on Ego (persuasion) vs. those attracted to your gender

Spider-Sense.name: Spider-Sense
Spider-Sense.description: The character has a sense of danger that tingles when threats are near.
Spider-Sense.effect: The character has an edge on initiative checks and on Vigilance checks to perceive danger. Enemies have trouble on Agility checks against the character's Vigilance defense. The character also gains a permanent +2 bonus to their Agility defense.
Spider-Sense.short_effect:
Edge on initiative and Vigilance checks to perceive danger
Enemies have trouble on Agility vs. your Vigilance
+2 to Agility defense

Spider-Strike.name: Spider-Strike
Spider-Strike.description: The character strikes in a blur of punches, kicks and webbing.
Spider-Strike.effect: The character splits their attack to make two close attacks against separate targets within reach (or they can focus a single attack on a single target). Make a single Melee check and compare it to the targets' Melee defenses. On a success, the affected target takes half regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the affected target takes full damage and is paralyzed by webbing. Breaking free from webbing requires a Melee check (target number 20). After the attacks, the character may run, jump or climb at half speed for free.
Spider-Strike.short_effect:
Single Melee check vs. two targets within reach (or one target)
• Success: Each takes ½ damage
• Fantastic: Each takes full damage and paralyzed by webbing (Melee check TN 20 to escape)
After attacks: Run/jump/climb at ½ speed for free

Spin & Throw.name: Spin & Throw
Spin & Throw.description: The character throws a grabbed foe to the ground.
Spin & Throw.trigger: An enemy the character can pick up is grabbed.
Spin & Throw.effect: The character makes a Melee attack against the grabbed foe. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage and is knocked prone. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage and is knocked prone, pinned and stunned for one round. Either way, the character can move the enemy to any open space within reach.
Spin & Throw.short_effect:
Melee attack vs. grabbed foe (reaction)
• Success: Regular damage, knocked prone, move enemy to any space within reach
• Fantastic: 2× damage, knocked prone, pinned, stunned for 1 round, move enemy

Static Illusion.name: Static Illusion
Static Illusion.description: By manipulating visual light, the character creates a realistic hologram.
Static Illusion.effect: The character creates a visual-only illusion anywhere in line of sight, within 50 spaces. The illusion can be of anything up to three sizes larger than the character, but it must be static. The character breaks concentration if they move beyond 50 spaces from the illusion or lose line of sight of it.
Static Illusion.short_effect:
Visual illusion (line of sight, 50 spaces, +3 sizes)
See through: Vigilance vs. Ego
Damage/concentration breaks it

Steal Powers.name: Steal Powers
Steal Powers.description: The character removes all of a target's powers and takes them for their own!
Steal Powers.effect: The character makes an Ego attack against the grabbed target. On a success, they remove all of the target's powers and take them for their own. They can now use those powers as if they were always theirs. If the target's powers have costs, the character must pay the highest of them, or a minimum of 15 Focus. When the character uses a power, they must pay any cost normally as well.
Steal Powers.short_effect:
Ego attack vs. grabbed target
• Success: Remove all target's powers and gain them
• Cost: Target's highest power cost or 15 Focus minimum
• Use stolen powers normally (paying costs)

Stilt Steps.name: Stilt Steps
Stilt Steps.description: The character can stretch their legs like extendable stilts.
Stilt Steps.effect: The character's Run Speed doubles, as does their Climb Speed.

Stopping Power.name: Stopping Power
Stopping Power.description: The character keeps shooting at the target.
Stopping Power.effect: The character makes a ranged attack on an enemy. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage, and the character can make another regular ranged attack on the same target.
Stopping Power.short_effect:
Ranged attack
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and make another regular ranged attack vs. same target

Sturdy 1.name: Sturdy 1
Sturdy 1.description: The character has protection from physical damage.
Sturdy 1.effect: The character's body is so sturdy that they have Health Damage Reduction 1. If this power stems from armor or anything else removable-like Iron Man's armor-the character should apply the Tech Reliance trait to it.
Sturdy 1.short_effect:
Health Damage Reduction 1
(If from removable armor/tech: Apply Tech Reliance trait)

Sturdy 2.name: Sturdy 2
Sturdy 2.description: The character is protected as if by steel.
Sturdy 2.effect: The character gains Health Damage Reduction 2.

Sturdy 3.name: Sturdy 3
Sturdy 3.description: The character is protected like a tank.
Sturdy 3.effect: The character gains Health Damage Reduction 3.

Sturdy 4.name: Sturdy 4
Sturdy 4.description: The character is protected like a battleship.
Sturdy 4.effect: The character gains Health Damage Reduction 4.

Summon Portal.name: Summon Portal
Summon Portal.description: The character opens a portal between space and dimensions.
Summon Portal.effect: The character opens a glowing portal in a space next to them that teleports anything that enters it between that space and its destination, which forms a matched glowing portal in the other place. This can be between any two points in the Multiverse, as long as the character has seen the destination. Anything can move through the portal in either direction until it is closed, which the character can do at will.
Summon Portal.short_effect:
Open two-way portal anywhere in Multiverse (must have seen destination)
Anything can travel through in either direction; close at will

Supernova.name: Supernova
Supernova.description: The character blasts out a massive burst of their element.
Supernova.effect: The character makes an Ego check and compares that against the Resilience defense of every enemy within 10 spaces. For these attacks, add +1 to the character's Melee damage bonus for every 2 points of Focus they spend. On a success, an affected target takes half that total damage. On a Fantastic success, an affected target takes full damage and suffers the elemental type's special effect.
Supernova.short_effect:
Ego vs. Resilience for all enemies within 10 spaces
+1 Melee damage per 2 Focus spent
• Success: Each takes ½ total damage
• Fantastic: Each takes full total damage and elemental special effect

Suppressive Fire.name: Suppressive Fire
Suppressive Fire.description: The character forces their foes to keep their heads down.
Suppressive Fire.effect: The character makes an Agility attack against a target's Vigilance defense. If the attack is a success, apply Health Damage Reduction normally. Any damage taken is then applied to the target's Focus instead. If it's a Fantastic success, the damage is doubled, and if the target takes any Focus damage, they are stunned for one round.
Suppressive Fire.short_effect:
Agility vs. Vigilance
• Success: Damage (after reduction) goes to target's Focus instead of your Health
• Fantastic: 2× damage to Focus and stunned for 1 round

Swipe Power.name: Swipe Power
Swipe Power.description: The character removes a target's power and takes it for their own!
Swipe Power.effect: The character makes an Ego attack against the grabbed target. On a success, they remove one of the target's powers and take it for their own. They can now use that power as if it was always theirs. If the power has a cost, the character must pay it or a minimum of 10 Focus. When the character uses the power, they must pay any cost normally as well.
Swipe Power.short_effect:
Ego attack vs. grabbed target
• Success: Remove one target power and gain it
• Cost: Power's cost or 10 Focus minimum
• Use stolen power normally (paying cost)

Telekinetic Attack.name: Telekinetic Attack
Telekinetic Attack.description: The character can punch or choke an enemy with their mind.
Telekinetic Attack.effect: The character makes a Logic attack against the Melee defense of a target within 5 spaces times the character's rank. If the attack is a success, it inflicts regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the damage is doubled instead, and the target is stunned for one round.
Telekinetic Attack.short_effect:
Logic vs. Melee (5 spaces × rank)
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and stunned for 1 round

Telekinetic Barrier.name: Telekinetic Barrier
Telekinetic Barrier.description: The character forms a protective barrier with their mind.
Telekinetic Barrier.effect: The character forms an invisible barrier in their line of sight and up to 10 spaces away per rank. This covers up to 2 spaces across (vertically/horizontally) per their rank. The character makes a Logic check and compares the results against the Agility defense of any target in the affected spaces. On a success, the character chooses which side of the barrier the target winds up on. On a failure, the target chooses. On a Fantastic success, the target is paralyzed for one round too. Attacks on the barrier are against the character's Logic defense. Any attacks on it that do 10 points of damage or less are instantly absorbed, and the barrier continues. If an attack does more than 10 points of damage, it destroys the barrier. Either way, the attack leaves those behind the barrier unharmed.
Telekinetic Barrier.short_effect:
Invisible barrier (2 spaces per rank, within 10 spaces/rank, line of sight)
• Logic vs. Agility defense: Choose which side target ends up (Fantastic: also paralyzed for 1 round)
• Absorbs ≤10 damage attacks; destroyed if >10 damage

Telekinetic Crush.name: Telekinetic Crush
Telekinetic Crush.description: The character mentally squeezes a foe.
Telekinetic Crush.effect: The character makes a Logic attack against the grabbed target's Resilience defense. If it's a success, the target takes regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the target takes double damage and is pinned.
Telekinetic Crush.short_effect:
Logic vs. Resilience (reaction vs. grabbed target)
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and pin

Telekinetic Grab.name: Telekinetic Grab
Telekinetic Grab.description: The character can grab a foe with their mind.
Telekinetic Grab.effect: The character makes a Logic attack against the Melee defense of a target within 5 spaces times the character's rank. If the attack is a success, the character grabs the target with their mind. On a Fantastic success, the target can also be pinned. Breaking free requires a successful Melee check against target number 20.
Telekinetic Grab.short_effect:
Logic vs. Melee (5 spaces × rank)
• Success: Grab target
• Fantastic: Grab and pin target
• Escape: Melee check TN 20

Telekinetic Manipulation.name: Telekinetic Manipulation
Telekinetic Manipulation.description: The character can handle physical things with their mind.
Telekinetic Manipulation.effect: The character can manipulate objects in their line of sight with their mind. The maximum range for this is 5 spaces times the character's rank. If someone tries to prevent the character from taking control of an object, the character makes a Logic check against the opponent's Agility defense.
Telekinetic Manipulation.short_effect:
Manipulate objects with mind (line of sight, 5 spaces × rank)
If contested: Logic vs. opponent's Agility

Telekinetic Protection 1.name: Telekinetic Protection 1
Telekinetic Protection 1.description: The character uses their mind to physically protect themselves.
Telekinetic Protection 1.trigger: The character is attacked or otherwise in danger.
Telekinetic Protection 1.effect: The character's personal telekinetic field protects them. Any attacks against them that do 10 points of damage or less are instantly absorbed, and the protection continues. If an attack does more than 10 points of damage, it destroys the protection. Either way, the character remains unharmed.
Telekinetic Protection 1.short_effect: Absorb attacks ≤10 damage; destroyed if >10 damage; you remain unharmed either way

Telekinetic Protection 2.name: Telekinetic Protection 2
Telekinetic Protection 2.description: The character toughens their mind against physical damage.
Telekinetic Protection 2.trigger: The character is attacked or otherwise in danger.
Telekinetic Protection 2.effect: The character's personal telekinetic field protects them. Any attacks against them that do 20 points of damage or less are instantly absorbed, and the protection continues. If an attack does more than 20 points of damage, it destroys the protection. Either way, the character remains unharmed.
Telekinetic Protection 2.short_effect: Absorb attacks ≤20 damage; destroyed if >20 damage; you remain unharmed either way

Telekinetic Protection 3.name: Telekinetic Protection 3
Telekinetic Protection 3.description: The character's mind protects them like a tank.
Telekinetic Protection 3.trigger: The character is attacked or otherwise in danger.
Telekinetic Protection 3.effect: The character's personal telekinetic field protects them. Any attacks against them that do 30 points of damage or less are instantly absorbed, and the protection continues. If an attack does more than 30 points of damage, it destroys the protection. Either way, the character remains unharmed.
Telekinetic Protection 3.short_effect: Absorb attacks ≤30 damage; destroyed if >30 damage; you remain unharmed either way

Telekinetic Protection 4.name: Telekinetic Protection 4
Telekinetic Protection 4.description: The character's mind protects them like a fortress.
Telekinetic Protection 4.trigger: The character is attacked or otherwise in danger.
Telekinetic Protection 4.effect: The character's personal telekinetic field grants them protection. Any attacks against them that do 40 points of damage or less are instantly absorbed, and the protection continues. If an attack does more than 40 points of damage, it destroys the protection. Either way, the character remains unharmed.
Telekinetic Protection 4.short_effect: Absorb attacks ≤40 damage; destroyed if >40 damage; you remain unharmed either way

Telekinetic Reinforcement.name: Telekinetic Reinforcement
Telekinetic Reinforcement.description: The character reinforces their defenses with their mind.
Telekinetic Reinforcement.trigger: A character using a telekinetic power that grants damage protection is attacked.
Telekinetic Reinforcement.effect: The character can transfer any Health damage that gets through a telekinetic power that grants damage protection to their Focus instead, leaving the protection intact.
Telekinetic Reinforcement.short_effect: Reaction: Transfer Health damage from telekinetic protection to Focus instead (keeps protection intact)

Telekinetic Sphere.name: Telekinetic Sphere
Telekinetic Sphere.description: The character can create a protective sphere with their mind.
Telekinetic Sphere.trigger: The character is attacked or otherwise in danger.
Telekinetic Sphere.cost: Same as the character's Telekinetic Protection power
Telekinetic Sphere.effect: The character envelops themselves-and any chosen people within up to 5 spaces times their rank-in a protective telekinetic sphere. When the sphere is formed, the character makes a Logic check and compares the results against the Agility defense of unwanted characters in the enclosed spaces. On a success, the character can move any unwanted people within the sphere's perimeter to spaces outside of the sphere. On a Fantastic success, such moved people suffer full damage. Attacks on the sphere are against the character's Logic defense. Any attacks on the sphere are absorbed as if made against the character's Telekinetic Protection power, and the sphere continues. If an attack does more damage than the character's Telekinetic Protection power can sustain, it destroys the sphere, but no one inside is harmed.
Telekinetic Sphere.short_effect:
Protective sphere around you and chosen allies (5 spaces × rank)
• Logic vs. Agility defense: Move unwanted targets outside sphere (Fantastic: also deal full damage)
• Absorbs damage per Telekinetic Protection level; destroyed if exceeded

Telekinetic Toss.name: Telekinetic Toss
Telekinetic Toss.description: The character can throw a foe around with their mind.
Telekinetic Toss.effect: The character can telekinetically throw a person that they've telekinetically grabbed at another target. The range for the throw is 5 spaces times the character's rank. The character makes a Logic check against the target's Agility defense. A failure inflicts regular damage on the thrown person, who falls prone within 1 space of the target. If the attack is a success, the target takes regular damage too. On a Fantastic success, the target is knocked prone as well.
Telekinetic Toss.short_effect:
Throw grabbed person at target (5 spaces × rank)
Logic vs. Agility defense
• Failure: Thrown person takes damage and falls prone within 1 space of target
• Success: Target also takes damage
• Fantastic: Target takes damage and knocked prone

Telepathic Blast.name: Telepathic Blast
Telepathic Blast.description: The character can mentally blast a foe's mind.
Telepathic Blast.effect: The character makes a Logic attack against a target in line of sight. If the attack is a success, it inflicts regular Focus damage. On a Fantastic success, the target takes double damage instead and is stunned for one round.
Telepathic Blast.short_effect:
Logic attack vs. target (line of sight; deals Focus damage)
• Success: Regular Focus damage
• Fantastic: 2× Focus damage and stunned for 1 round

Telepathic Link.name: Telepathic Link
Telepathic Link.description: The character can speak with another telepathically.
Telepathic Link.effect: The character can communicate telepathically with one person at a time, and they must have met or seen the other person before. The communication can be verbal, visual or even more complex, such as imparting location information. There is no limit to the distance of the communication, as long as the character and the target are in the same dimension. If the other person does not wish to speak with the character, the target can automatically tune them out. To force a telepathic link, the character can make a Logic check against the target's Vigilance defense. On a failure, the character cannot attempt to communicate with the target in this way for the rest of the day. On a success, the character can communicate with the target for one round. On a Fantastic success, the target cannot shut the character out for the rest of the day.
Telepathic Link.short_effect:
Communicate telepathically with met/seen person (any distance, same dimension)
Target can tune you out
Force link: Logic vs. Vigilance (Fail: can't try rest of day; Success: 1 round; Fantastic: can't shut you out rest of day)

Telepathic Network.name: Telepathic Network
Telepathic Network.description: The character can speak telepathically with a group of people.
Telepathic Network.effect: The character can communicate telepathically with a group of willing, linked people, each of whom they have met or seen before. The communication can be verbal, visual or even more complex, such as imparting location information. The group can number up to five people per rank. There is no limit to the distance of the communication, as long as everyone involved is in the same dimension.
Telepathic Network.short_effect: Communicate telepathically with group of willing linked people (any distance, same dimension)

Telepathic Possession.name: Telepathic Possession
Telepathic Possession.description: The character mentally takes over someone else's body.
Telepathic Possession.effect: The character possesses a target with whom they've established a Telepathic Link and who has no Focus left. The character makes a Logic check with trouble against the target's Logic defense. On a success, the character takes over the target's body completely. The result of the character's check is the target number for any attempts by the target to end the possession. If the character attempts to harm someone with the possessed body, the target gets to make a Logic check to end the possession. If the target has the Heroic tag, they get an edge on the check. If the character attempts to harm the possessed body, the target gets an edge on the check. If the target has the Heroic tag, they get a double edge. This power can also be used to transfer the character's mind into an empty-minded target-like a fresh clone or android-permanently. This requires no check, as there is no one in the body to challenge the character's action.
Telepathic Possession.short_effect:
Logic with trouble vs. Logic (telepathic link target with 0 Focus)
• Success: Take over body (your check = TN to end)
Harm someone: Target checks to end (Heroic: edge; harm self: double edge)
Transfer to empty-minded (clone/android): No check, permanent

Teleport 1.name: Teleport 1
Teleport 1.effect: The character teleports into a clear space they can see or have been to, up to 10 times their rank in spaces away. Outside of combat, they can teleport up to 100 times their rank in spaces away.
Teleport 1.short_effect: Teleport to visible/visited clear space (10 × rank in combat; 1,000 × rank outside combat)

Teleport 2.name: Teleport 2
Teleport 2.effect: Outside of combat, the character can teleport up to 1,000 times their rank in spaces away.
Teleport 2.short_effect: Outside combat: Teleport up to 1,000× rank spaces

Teleport Blind.name: Teleport Blind
Teleport Blind.description: The character teleports someplace new to them.
Teleport Blind.effect: The character teleports to someplace they've never been and never seen, up to 10 times their rank in spaces away. Outside of combat, they can teleport up to 100 times their rank in spaces away. If the character teleports into something solid, they are automatically pushed out of it but take damage from the disruption equal to a standard action check. The damage multiplier is 1 for every space they must move to reach a clear area. If this kills them, their body is trapped inside the material they teleported into.
Teleport Blind.short_effect:
Teleport to unseen place (10 × rank spaces in combat; 100 × rank outside combat)
If teleport into solid object: Pushed out, take damage (multiplier = spaces moved; death traps body)

Teleport Object.name: Teleport Object
Teleport Object.description: The character can teleport something else with them.
Teleport Object.effect: The character can teleport along with them an object within reach as far away as their Teleport power normally allows them. The object (and things attached to or inside of it) can be up to their rank in sizes bigger than them. For example, if they are Rank 4, the object can be up to four sizes bigger than them.
Teleport Object.short_effect:
Teleport object within reach along with you (your Teleport power range)
Object can't exceed your size + rank in sizes

Teleport Other.name: Teleport Other
Teleport Other.description: The character can teleport someone else away.
Teleport Other.effect: The character makes an Ego check against the Vigilance defense of a target they have grabbed. If the check is successful, the character can teleport the target as far away as their Teleport power normally allows them in combat. If the target winds up in something solid, they are automatically pushed out of it but take damage from the disruption equal to a standard action check. The damage multiplier is 1 for every space they must move to reach a clear area. If this kills them, their body is trapped inside the material they teleported into.
Teleport Other.short_effect:
Ego vs. Vigilance (grabbed target)
• Success: Teleport target away (your Teleport power range)
If into solid object: Pushed out, take damage (multiplier = spaces moved; death traps body)

Teleport Together.name: Teleport Together
Teleport Together.description: The character can teleport someone they are touching.
Teleport Together.effect: The character teleports, taking any person they are touching with them, into clear spaces they can see or have been to, up to 10 times their rank in spaces away. Outside of combat, they can teleport up to 100 times their rank in spaces away. If the target does not wish to be teleported, the character must grab them first.
Teleport Together.short_effect:
Teleport with person you're touching (must grab unwilling target)
Visible/visited clear space (10 × rank in combat; 100 × rank outside combat)

Teleportal.name: Teleportal
Teleportal.description: The character opens a portal to another place.
Teleportal.effect: The character opens a glowing portal in a space next to them that teleports anything that enters it between that space and its destination, which forms a matched glowing portal in the other place. The other end of the portal must be in a clear space the character can see or has been to, up to 10 times their rank in spaces away. Outside of combat, they can teleport up to 1,000 times their rank in spaces away. Anything can move through the portal in either direction until it is closed, which the character can do at will.
Teleportal.short_effect:
Open two-way portal (visible/visited location, 10 × rank in combat; 1,000 × rank outside combat)
Anything can travel through in either direction; close at will

Thunder.name: Thunder
Thunder.description: The character causes a deafening crack of thunder.
Thunder.effect: The character makes an Ego check and compares that against the Resilience defense of every character within 10 spaces. Any character the attack succeeds against is deafened. On a Fantastic success, the character is also stunned for one round.
Thunder.short_effect:
Ego vs. Resilience for all within 10 spaces
• Success: Deafened
• Fantastic: Deafened and stunned for 1 round

Time-Out.name: Time-Out
Time-Out.trigger: The character or an ally is attacked.
Time-Out.effect: The character freezes time for everyone but themselves. During this period, they can act normally while everyone else seems to be frozen in place.
Time-Out.short_effect:
Freeze time for everyone but you
Everyone else frozen while you act normally

Time-Out Bubble.name: Time-Out Bubble
Time-Out Bubble.description: The character and allies step out of time.
Time-Out Bubble.trigger: The character or an ally is attacked.
Time-Out Bubble.effect: The character creates a time bubble that affects themselves and any chosen allies within 1 space per rank. Within the bubble, the character and those allies can act normally while everyone else seems to be frozen in place.
Time-Out Bubble.short_effect:
Time bubble: You + chosen allies (1 space/rank) act normally
Everyone else frozen

Time-Out Tag.name: Time-Out Tag
Time-Out Tag.description: The character freezes a person or thing in time.
Time-Out Tag.trigger: The character or an ally is attacked.
Time-Out Tag.effect: The character freezes time for one person or thing within their reach. Everything and everyone else can act normally. If the target does not wish to be frozen, the character must grab them first.
Time-Out Tag.short_effect:
Freeze time for one person/thing within reach (must grab unwilling)
Everyone else acts normally

Time Portal.name: Time Portal
Time Portal.description: The character opens a portal in time.
Time Portal.effect: The character opens a glowing portal in a space next to them that moves anything that enters it between that space and its destination, which forms a matched glowing portal in the other place. The other end of the portal must be in a clear space in another period of time, in roughly the same place. Anything can move through the portal in either direction until it is closed, which the character can do at will.
Time Portal.short_effect:
Open two-way portal to another time period (roughly same place)
Anything can travel through in either direction; close at will

Time Travel.name: Time Travel
Time Travel.description: The character moves from one time to another.
Time Travel.effect: The character instantly moves from their current time to another time-for instance, from the present to 1962. When they move to the other time, they can arrive in any place they've been to before. Otherwise, they arrive at the closest available corresponding space in the other time.
Time Travel.short_effect:
Instantly travel to another time
Arrive at place you've visited, or closest corresponding space

Time Travel Other.name: Time Travel Other
Time Travel Other.description: The character sends someone to another time.
Time Travel Other.effect: The character makes an Ego check against the Vigilance defense of a target they have grabbed. If the check is successful, the character can send the target to another time. The target can be sent to any location in that time that the character has been to before. Otherwise, the target arrives at the closest available corresponding space in the other time.
Time Travel Other.short_effect:
Ego vs. Vigilance (grabbed target)
• Success: Send target to another time (place you've visited or closest corresponding space)

Time Travel Together.name: Time Travel Together
Time Travel Together.description: The character brings someone with them to another time.
Time Travel Together.effect: The character moves to a different time, taking any person they are touching with them. If the target does not wish to come along, the character must grab them first. When they move to the other time, they can arrive in any place they've been to before. Otherwise, they arrive at the closest available corresponding space in the other time.
Time Travel Together.short_effect:
Travel to another time with person you're touching (must grab unwilling target)
Arrive at place you've visited, or closest corresponding space

Uncanny 1.name: Uncanny 1
Uncanny 1.description: The character has protection against mental assaults.
Uncanny 1.effect: Any damage multiplier for attacks against the character's Focus is reduced by 1. If this power is part of a battle suit, the power is integrated into a removable helmet. Otherwise, it's a part of the character. If this power stems from armor or anything else removable-like Magneto's helmet-the character should apply the Tech Reliance trait to it.
Uncanny 1.short_effect:
Focus Damage Reduction 1
(If from removable helmet/armor: Apply Tech Reliance trait)

Uncanny 2.name: Uncanny 2
Uncanny 2.description: The character's mind is protected as if by steel.
Uncanny 2.effect: Any damage multiplier for attacks against the character's Focus is reduced by 2.

Uncanny 3.name: Uncanny 3
Uncanny 3.description: The character's mind is protected like a tank.
Uncanny 3.effect: Any damage multiplier for attacks against the character's Focus is reduced by 3.

Uncanny 4.name: Uncanny 4
Uncanny 4.description: The character's mind is protected like a battleship.
Uncanny 4.effect: Any damage multiplier for attacks against the character's Focus is reduced by 4.

Unflappable Poise.name: Unflappable Poise
Unflappable Poise.description: The character can dodge most close attacks.
Unflappable Poise.effect: Any close attacks against the character have trouble. While they use Defense Stance, such attacks have double trouble.
Unflappable Poise.short_effect:
Close attacks vs. you have trouble
While using Defense Stance: Close attacks have double trouble

Unrelenting Smash.name: Unrelenting Smash
Unrelenting Smash.description: The character smashes everything in reach.
Unrelenting Smash.effect: The character makes a Melee check and compares it against the Melee defense of every enemy within their reach. Any enemy the attack succeeds against takes half regular damage. On a Fantastic success, those enemies take full regular damage and are knocked prone instead. The character may then pay 15 more Focus to do the same thing again-before which they can move up to half their speed with anything left from their normal movement action. They can keep doing this until they run out of speed or Focus. Each target can be affected by this attack by this character only once per round.
Unrelenting Smash.short_effect:
Melee vs. all enemies within reach
• Success: Each takes ½ damage
• Fantastic: Each takes full damage and knocked prone
Pay 15 Focus to repeat (can move up to ½ speed between); each target affected once per round

Unstoppable Assault.name: Unstoppable Assault
Unstoppable Assault.description: The character hews a path through their foes.
Unstoppable Assault.effect: The character makes a Melee check and compares that against the Melee defense of every enemy within their reach. Any enemy the attack succeeds against takes half regular damage. On a Fantastic success, those enemies take full regular damage instead and suffer the weapon's special effect. The character may then pay 15 more Focus to do the same thing again-before which they can move up to half their Speed with whatever is left from their normal movement action. They can keep doing this until they run out of Speed or Focus. Each target can only be affected by this attack by this character once per round.
Unstoppable Assault.short_effect:
Melee vs. all enemies within reach
• Success: Each takes ½ damage
• Fantastic: Each takes full damage and weapon special effect
Pay 15 Focus to repeat (can move up to ½ speed between); each target affected once per round

Untouchable Position.name: Untouchable Position
Untouchable Position.description: The character's enemies struggle to gang up on them.
Untouchable Position.effect: If the character is attacked, all other close attacks against them have trouble until the start of their next turn.
Untouchable Position.short_effect: If attacked: All other close attacks vs. you have trouble until start of your next turn

Vapors of Valtorr.name: Vapors of Valtorr
Vapors of Valtorr.description: The character weaves an inky mist that can attack those inside it.
Vapors of Valtorr.effect: The character creates an inky mist for up to 25 spaces per rank around them that blocks all line of sight beyond 5 spaces. On later turns, the character can have the mist attacks one target at a time. Make an Ego check against the target's Vigilance defense. On a success, the attack does regular damage. On a Fantastic success, it does double damage and blinds the target for one turn.
Vapors of Valtorr.short_effect:
Create mist (25 spaces/rank); blocks line of sight beyond 5 spaces
Later turns: Mist attacks one target
• Ego vs. Vigilance: Success = damage; Fantastic = 2× damage and blind for 1 turn

Venom Blast.name: Venom Blast
Venom Blast.description: The character unleashes a bioelectric shock.
Venom Blast.effect: The character makes a ranged attack. If the attack is a success, it does regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the attack does double damage, and if the target suffers any actual damage, they are also stunned for one round.
Venom Blast.short_effect:
Ranged attack
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and stunned for 1 round (if any damage dealt)

Vicious Attack.name: Vicious Attack
Vicious Attack.description: The character strikes a felling blow.
Vicious Attack.effect: The character makes a close attack. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage and suffers the weapon's special effect.
Vicious Attack.short_effect:
Close attack
• Success: Regular damage
• Fantastic: 2× damage and weapon special effect

Wallcrawling.name: Wallcrawling
Wallcrawling.description: The character can climb like a spider.
Wallcrawling.effect: The character can climb at a speed equal to their regular speed. Under normal conditions, they never lose their grip, no matter the angle of the surface.
Wallcrawling.short_effect:
Climb at regular speed
Never lose grip on any surface angle

Weapons Blazing.name: Weapons Blazing
Weapons Blazing.description: The character blazes away at two foes at once.
Weapons Blazing.effect: The character splits their attack to make two ranged attacks against separate targets (or they can focus a single attack on a single target). Make a single Agility check and compare it to the targets' Agility defenses. On a success, the affected target takes half regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the affected target takes full damage, and the character can make a bonus attack with this power against any available target, with the same effect.
Weapons Blazing.short_effect:
Single Agility check vs. two targets (or one target)
• Success: Each takes ½ damage
• Fantastic: Each takes full damage, plus bonus attack vs. any target

Weather Chill.name: Weather Chill
Weather Chill.effect: The temperature in an area roughly a mile across falls as low as 0°F.

Weather Warm.name: Weather Warm
Weather Warm.effect: The temperature in an area roughly a mile across climbs as high as 100°F.

Webcasting.name: Webcasting
Webcasting.description: The character can snare a target in a web.
Webcasting.effect: The character makes a ranged attack on an enemy. If the attack is a success, the web paralyzes the enemy. On a Fantastic success, the enemy is also pinned. Breaking free from webbing requires a Melee check (target number 20).
Webcasting.short_effect:
Ranged attack
• Success: Paralyze enemy
• Fantastic: Paralyze and pin enemy
• Escape: Melee check TN 20

Webgliding.name: Webgliding
Webgliding.description: The character can glide through the air on their webbing.
Webgliding.effect: The character gains the Glide movement mode, with a speed equal to double their Run Speed.
Webgliding.short_effect: Gain Glide movement mode; Glide Speed = 2× Run Speed

Webgrabbing.name: Webgrabbing
Webgrabbing.description: The character snares a foe in a web.
Webgrabbing.effect: The character makes a ranged attack on an enemy. If the attack is a success, the character grabs the target with a web. On a Fantastic success, the target can also be pinned. Breaking free from webbing requires a Melee check (target number 20).
Webgrabbing.short_effect:
Ranged attack
• Success: Grab target with web
• Fantastic: Grab and pin target
• Escape: Melee check TN 20

Webslinging.name: Webslinging
Webslinging.description: The character can swing through the city on their webs.
Webslinging.effect: The character gains the swingline movement mode, with a Speed equal to triple their Run Speed. The reach of their swingline is equal to their Swingline Speed.
Webslinging.short_effect:
Gain Swingline movement mode; Swingline Speed = 3× Run Speed
Swingline reach = Swingline Speed

Webtrapping.name: Webtrapping
Webtrapping.description: The character creates a giant web to trap those within it.
Webtrapping.effect: The character fills up to 5 spaces with sticky webs, and the affected spaces are considered difficult terrain. Any creature that starts its turn in or moves into an affected space must make an Agility check (target number 20) or be paralyzed by the webbing. Breaking free from webbing requires a Melee check (target number 20).
Webtrapping.short_effect:
Fill up to 5 spaces with webs (difficult terrain)
Creature starting turn in or moving into space: Agility check TN 20 or paralyzed
• Escape: Melee check TN 20

Whirling Frenzy.name: Whirling Frenzy
Whirling Frenzy.description: The character assaults a foe with a tornado of whirling attacks.
Whirling Frenzy.effect: The character makes an Agility check and compares it against the Agility defense of every enemy within their reach. If an attack is a success, the enemy takes half regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes full damage and suffers the weapon's special effect.
Whirling Frenzy.short_effect:
Agility vs. all enemies within reach
• Success: Each takes ½ damage
• Fantastic: Each takes full damage and weapon special effect

Winds of Watoomb.name: Winds of Watoomb
Winds of Watoomb.description: The character creates swirling winds for protection.
Winds of Watoomb.trigger: Damage gets through the Shield of the Seraphim
Winds of Watoomb.effect: The character conjures swirling winds that they control. All movement by a foe within 10 spaces per the character's rank is cut in half. The character can also use this spell to push away smoke, mist or fog. If such a thing was created by a power, the character makes an Ego check with an edge against the Ego defense of the opposing controller. On a success, the controller's power ends. On a Fantastic success, the controller is knocked prone. Additionally, the Winds of Watoomb can be used to reinforce the Shield of the Seraphim. The character can transfer any Health damage that gets through the Shield of the Seraphim's protection to their Focus instead, leaving the Shield of the Seraphim intact.
Winds of Watoomb.short_effect:
Foes within 10 spaces/rank: Movement halved
Push away smoke/mist/fog: Ego check with edge vs. controller's Ego defense (Success: End power; Fantastic: Also knock prone)
Reinforce Shield of Seraphim: Transfer Health damage through shield to Focus (keeps shield intact)

Wisdom.name: Wisdom
Wisdom.description: The character not only has brains but knows when to use them.
Wisdom.effect: The character can use their Ego defense score against Logic attacks too.
Wisdom.short_effect: Use Ego defense vs. Logic attacks

Wisecracker.name: Wisecracker
Wisecracker.description: The character irritates a foe with their sharp wit.
Wisecracker.trigger: The character succeeds in an attack on an enemy in earshot, or an enemy in earshot fails an attack on them.
Wisecracker.effect: The character cracks a joke at the enemy's expense. Make an Ego attack. On a success, it does regular Focus damage. On a Fantastic success, the damage is doubled, and the target is stunned for one round.
Wisecracker.short_effect:
Ego attack (deals Focus damage)
• Success: Regular Focus damage
• Fantastic: 2× Focus damage and stunned for 1 round
